items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet from Unit 1 Section 2:
Galang: "Was the river this dirty back then? Did you swim in the river?"
Pak Rahmansyah: "I did! The river was quite clean back then. A lot of kids swam and played in the river."

What condition was Sungai Lestari in when Pak Rahmansyah was a child?
options: It was clean and local children often swam and played in it.
It was already filled with plastic trash and polluted.
It was deep and dangerous so children were forbidden to go near.
It was dried up because of a severe drought in the nearby town.

why.0: Teks percakapan menyebutkan bahwa dahulu Sungai Lestari cukup bersih ("quite clean back then") dan banyak anak-anak berenang serta bermain di sana.

distractorWhy.1: Pernyataan ini bertentangan dengan penjelasan Pak Rahmansyah yang menyatakan bahwa sungai tersebut dahulu masih bersih.
distractorWhy.2: Dialog tidak menyebutkan sungai itu berbahaya atau melarang anak-anak mendekat, melainkan menceritakan bahwa banyak anak bermain di sungai.
distractorWhy.3: Teks tidak menyebutkan terjadinya kekeringan atau sungai kering.

items.prompt: Based on Bu Posma's explanation in Unit 1 Section 2, why does plastic trash cause long-term pollution in rivers like Sungai Lestari?
options: Because plastic does not decay easily and accumulates in many places.
Because plastic dissolves instantly in water and poisons river fish.
Because plastic turns into organic fertilizer that attracts algae.
Because plastic sinks to the bottom and burns underwater.

why.0: Bu Posma menjelaskan bahwa sampah plastik menjadi masalah utama karena tidak mudah terurai ("plastic does not decay easily") sehingga mengotori berbagai tempat.

distractorWhy.1: Plastik tidak larut secara instan dalam air, melainkan justru sangat sulit terurai.
distractorWhy.2: Plastik adalah bahan anorganik dan tidak berubah menjadi pupuk organik.
distractorWhy.3: Plastik yang berada di dalam air sungai tidak terbakar di bawah air.

items.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct interrogative sentence in Simple Past tense based on Language Focus Unit 1:
options: Did people throw their trash into the river?
Did people threw their trash into the river?
Was people throw their trash into the river?
Were people threw their trash into the river?

why.0: Dalam kalimat tanya Simple Past Tense menggunakan kata bantu "Did", kata kerja utama kembali ke bentuk dasar (infinitive/Verb 1), yaitu "throw".

distractorWhy.1: Kata kerja setelah kata bantu "Did" harus berupa Verb 1 ("throw"), bukan kata kerja bentuk lampau ("threw").
distractorWhy.2: Kata bantu "Was" tidak digunakan bersama kata kerja aksi ("throw") dalam struktur kalimat tanya sederhana ini.
distractorWhy.3: Kata bantu "Were" tidak dipadukan dengan Verb 2 ("threw") dalam pembentukan kalimat tanya Simple Past.

items.prompt: In Audio 4.2 (Unit 1), what main obstacle caused the rainwater to back up and flood the area after the heavy rain?
options: Almost all gutters were clogged and full of plastic trash.
The river dam broke due to an earthquake.
The local residents blocked the water pipes intentionally.
The sea level rose suddenly and flooded the town.

why.0: Petugas penyelamat melaporkan bahwa saluran air (gutters) tersumbat dan penuh dengan sampah plastik sehingga air hujan meluap.

distractorWhy.1: Teks tidak menyebutkan adanya bendungan yang jebol akibat gempa bumi.
distractorWhy.2: Tidak ada informasi mengenai warga yang sengaja menyumbat pipa air.
distractorWhy.3: Banjir disebabkan oleh hujan lebat dan saluran air yang tersumbat sampah plastik, bukan oleh kenaikan permukaan laut.

items.prompt:
Complete the sentence with the correct past form of 'be' based on Language Focus Unit 1:
"In some areas of the town, many houses _____ almost underwater during the flood."
options: were
was
is
are

why.0: Subjek kalimat adalah "many houses" (jamak/plural), sehingga kata bantu 'be' dalam bentuk lampau yang tepat adalah "were".

distractorWhy.1: Bentuk "was" digunakan untuk subjek tunggal (singular), sedangkan subjek kalimat ini jamak.
distractorWhy.2: Bentuk "is" merupakan to be present tense untuk subjek tunggal, tidak cocok untuk konteks kejadian masa lalu.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk "are" merupakan to be present tense, padahal kalimat menceritakan peristiwa di masa lalu (past tense).

items.prompt: Which of the following questions correctly asks about the state of the gutters in the past using Was/Were?
options: Were the gutters full of plastic trash after the storm?
Did the gutters was full of plastic trash after the storm?
Was the gutters full of plastic trash after the storm?
Were the gutters filled trash do after the storm?

why.0: Subjek "the gutters" berbentuk jamak, sehingga kalimat tanya nominal di masa lalu diawali dengan "Were" diikuti subjek dan kata sifat/frasa preposisi.

distractorWhy.1: Penggabungan kata bantu "Did" dan "was" secara bersamaan dalam satu klausa tidak sesuai tata bahasa.
distractorWhy.2: Bentuk "Was" seharusnya digunakan untuk subjek tunggal, sedangkan "the gutters" adalah kata benda jamak.
distractorWhy.3: Susunan kata dan penggunaan "filled trash do" tidak memenuhi struktur tata bahasa yang valid.

items.prompt:
Read the excerpt from Unit 2 Section 3:
"A team of scientists from Texas University helped an injured sea turtle when they sailed in the ocean near Costa Rica. The scientists were collecting data on sea turtles when they saw the injured turtle."

Where were the scientists when they spotted the injured sea turtle?
options: In the ocean near Costa Rica.
At a turtle breeding center in Texas.
On a public beach in Kuta, Bali.
In a laboratory at Texas University.

why.0: Teks bacaan menyebutkan bahwa para ilmuwan sedang berlayar di samudra dekat Costa Rica ketika mereka melihat penyu yang terluka.

distractorWhy.1: Meskipun para ilmuwan berasal dari Texas University, lokasi penemuan penyu berada di laut dekat Costa Rica.
distractorWhy.2: Pantai Kuta Bali merupakan latar lokasi untuk cerita di Unit 3 (gerakan Bye Bye Plastic Bags), bukan cerita penyu di Unit 2.
distractorWhy.3: Para ilmuwan melihat penyu saat berlayar di laut, bukan di dalam laboratorium.

items.prompt: Based on the story in Unit 2 Section 3, what object did the scientists pull out of the injured sea turtle's nostril?
options: A plastic straw.
A sharp fish hook.
A piece of fishing net.
A dangerous natural parasite.

why.0: Hasil pemeriksaan menunjukkan bahwa benda yang tersumbat di lubang hidung penyu adalah sedotan plastik ("plastic straw").

distractorWhy.1: Teks tidak menyebutkan adanya kail pancing.
distractorWhy.2: Benda yang dikeluarkan dari hidung penyu adalah sedotan plastik, bukan jaring ikan.
distractorWhy.3: Ilmuwan awalnya mengira itu mungkin parasit, tetapi setelah ditarik ternyata benda tersebut adalah sedotan plastik.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the Past Continuous Tense correctly to describe an action in progress in the past?
options: The scientists were collecting data on sea turtles when they saw the turtle.
The scientists was collecting data on sea turtles when they saw the turtle.
The scientists were collect data on sea turtles when they saw the turtle.
The scientists collected data while they were see the turtle.

why.0: Subjek "The scientists" (jamak) berpasangan dengan "were" dan kata kerja berakhiran -ing ("collecting") untuk membentuk Past Continuous Tense.

distractorWhy.1: Subjek jamak "The scientists" harus menggunakan "were", bukan "was".
distractorWhy.2: Past Continuous Tense membutuhkan kata kerja berakhiran -ing ("collecting"), bukan bentuk dasar ("collect").
distractorWhy.3: Kata kerja setelah "were" harus berbentuk V-ing ("seeing"), bukan bentuk dasar ("see").

items.prompt:
Complete the Wh- question based on Language Focus Unit 2:
"______ did the team of scientists sail when they found the injured turtle?"
Answer: "They sailed in the ocean near Costa Rica."
options: Where
What
Why
Who

why.0: Kata tanya "Where" digunakan untuk menanyakan tempat atau lokasi ("in the ocean near Costa Rica").

distractorWhy.1: Kata tanya "What" digunakan untuk menanyakan benda atau tindakan, bukan lokasi.
distractorWhy.2: Kata tanya "Why" digunakan untuk menanyakan alasan atau sebab.
distractorWhy.3: Kata tanya "Who" digunakan untuk menanyakan orang atau pelaku.

items.prompt: Choose the correct structure for asking about the reason why the scientists caught the turtle in Simple Past tense:
options: Why did the scientists catch the sea turtle?
Why did the scientists caught the sea turtle?
Why were the scientists caught the sea turtle?
Why the scientists did catch the sea turtle?

why.0: Formasi pertanyaan Wh- Simple Past menggunakan pola: Wh-word + did + subject + Verb 1 ("catch").

distractorWhy.1: Setelah kata bantu "did", kata kerja yang digunakan harus berupa Verb 1 ("catch"), bukan Verb 2 ("caught").
distractorWhy.2: Penggunaan to be "were" bersama dengan Verb 2 "caught" dalam struktur pertanyaan ini tidak tepat.
distractorWhy.3: Urutan kata menyimpang karena kata bantu "did" diletakkan setelah subjek.

items.prompt: Based on the story in Unit 2 Section 3, how long did it take for the scientists to pull the plastic straw out of the turtle's nostril?
options: About 10 minutes.
About 2 hours.
The entire afternoon.
More than two days.

why.0: Teks menyatakan dengan jelas bahwa proses mengeluarkan sedotan plastik dari hidung penyu memakan waktu sekitar 10 menit ("about 10 minutes").

distractorWhy.1: Durasi 2 jam merujuk pada lamanya hujan turun pada kejadian banjir di Unit 1, bukan waktu pencabutan sedotan plastik.
distractorWhy.2: Teks tidak menyebutkan bahwa proses tersebut berlangsung sepanjang sore.
distractorWhy.3: Waktu 10 menit jauh lebih singkat daripada dua hari.

items.prompt: Identify the sentence that correctly combines Past Continuous and Simple Past using 'when' based on Language Focus Unit 2:
options: The turtle was swimming near the boat when the scientists noticed the object.
The turtle is swimming near the boat when the scientists notice the object.
The turtle swam near the boat when the scientists were notice the object.
The turtle was swam near the boat when the scientists noticing the object.

why.0: Kalimat ini secara tepat menggabungkan kejadian yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu ("was swimming") dengan kejadian singkat yang menyela ("noticed") menggunakan kata hubung "when".

distractorWhy.1: Kalimat tersebut menggunakan Present Continuous dan Present Simple, bukan struktur lampau (Past Tense).
distractorWhy.2: Bentuk "were notice" tidak sesuai kaidah tata bahasa bahasa Inggris.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk "was swam" dan "noticing" menyalahi aturan pembentukan Past Continuous dan Simple Past.

items.prompt:
Read the excerpt from Unit 3 Section 2:
"Melati and Isabel Wijsen live in Bali. They spent their teenage years cleaning up the island from plastic. Melati and Isabel were only 12 and 10 years old when they decided to tackle plastic pollution."

What movement did Melati and Isabel Wijsen start in Bali?
options: Bye Bye Plastic Bags.
Save the Forest Campaign.
Clean Water Project.
No More Chemical Waste.

why.0: Teks dan informasi pendukung di Unit 3 menyebutkan gerakan yang diprakarsai oleh Melati dan Isabel Wijsen bernama "Bye Bye Plastic Bags".

distractorWhy.1: Gerakan kedua bersaudara tersebut berfokus pada polusi sampah plastik, bukan penyelamatan hutan.
distractorWhy.2: Fokus utama kampanye mereka adalah pengurangan sampah plastik di Bali, bukan proyek air bersih.
distractorWhy.3: Teks secara khusus membahas tentang kantong plastik dan sampah plastik, bukan limbah kimia.

items.prompt: Based on Unit 3 Section 4, what is the main purpose of the 'Orientation' section in a factual recount text?
options: To introduce the background information such as who, where, when, and why the event happened.
To state the author's final personal feeling or recommendation at the very end of the text.
To list all step-by-step chronological actions taken by the main characters.
To present a fictional story with magical resolution.

why.0: Bagian Orientation berfungsi memperkenalkan informasi latar belakang seperti siapa (who), di mana (where), kapan (when), dan mengapa (why) peristiwa tersebut terjadi.

distractorWhy.1: Pernyataan kesan akhir atau evaluasi merupakan fungsi dari bagian Comment / Re-orientation.
distractorWhy.2: Urutan kejadian kronologis merupakan bagian dari Records of Events.
distractorWhy.3: Factual recount menyajikan cerita berdasarkan fakta nyata, bukan cerita rekaan imajinatif atau magis.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses 'when' at the beginning of a complex sentence with proper punctuation according to Language Focus Unit 3?
options: When Melati and Isabel went hiking to Mount Batur, they saw plastic bottles along the way.
When Melati and Isabel went hiking to Mount Batur they saw plastic bottles along the way.
When Melati and Isabel went hiking to Mount Batur, and they saw plastic bottles along the way.
When did Melati and Isabel went hiking to Mount Batur, they saw plastic bottles.

why.0: Ketika klausa "when" diletakkan di awal kalimat, koma (,) wajib digunakan untuk memisahkan klausa anak dari klausa utama.

distractorWhy.1: Kalimat tersebut kekurangan tanda koma yang diperlukan untuk memisahkan klausa "when" di awal kalimat.
distractorWhy.2: Penggunaan kata hubung tambahan "and" setelah koma adalah redundan dan tidak tepat.
distractorWhy.3: Penggunaan struktur kalimat tanya "did ... went" pada klausa anak di awal kalimat adalah salah secara tata bahasa.

items.prompt:
Combine these two events into a single sentence using 'when' based on Language Focus Unit 3:
Event 1: "The scientists were collecting data on sea turtles."
Event 2: "They spotted an injured sea turtle swimming near their boat."
options: The scientists were collecting data on sea turtles when they spotted an injured sea turtle.
The scientists were collecting data on sea turtles when were they spot an injured sea turtle.
When were the scientists collecting data on sea turtles they spotted an injured sea turtle.
The scientists collect data on sea turtles when they were spotted an injured sea turtle.

why.0: Kalimat ini secara tepat menyambungkan aksi yang berlangsung ("were collecting data") dengan kejadian penyela ("spotted") menggunakan kata penghubung "when".

distractorWhy.1: Bentuk "when were they spot" salah secara tata bahasa.
distractorWhy.2: Klausa "when" di awal memerlukan koma pemisah, dan frasa "When were the scientists" berstruktur kalimat tanya yang tidak sesuai.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk "they were spotted" bermakna pasif ("mereka ditemukan") yang mengubah makna cerita asli.

items.prompt: In waste sorting and management, items such as plastic bottles, plastic straws, and aluminum cans are categorized as:
options: Inorganic waste
Organic waste
Hazardous waste (B3)
Compostable waste

why.0: Botol plastik, sedotan plastik, dan kaleng aluminium merupakan limbah anorganik (inorganic waste) yang tidak dapat terurai secara hayati.

distractorWhy.1: Limbah organik terdiri dari bahan hayati yang mudah membusuk seperti sisa makanan dan dedaunan.
distractorWhy.2: Limbah B3 (bahan berbahaya dan beracun) meliputi baterai, lampu, dan zat kimia berbahaya.
distractorWhy.3: Sampah plastik dan aluminium tidak dapat diolah menjadi kompos.

items.prompt: Which group of waste items should be sorted specifically into the Hazardous Waste (B3) bin?
options: Used batteries, fluorescent light bulbs, and aerosol spray cans.
Banana peels, leftover rice, and dry tree leaves.
Plastic shopping bags, plastic bottles, and plastic cutlery.
Cardboard boxes, newspaper sheets, and paper bags.

why.0: Baterai bekas, lampu neon, dan kaleng aerosol mengandung zat kimia berbahaya dan beracun sehingga termasuk dalam kategori limbah B3 (Hazardous Waste).

distractorWhy.1: Kulit pisang, sisa nasi, dan daun kering adalah contoh limbah organik.
distractorWhy.2: Kantong plastik, botol plastik, dan sendok plastik adalah contoh limbah anorganik non-B3.
distractorWhy.3: Kardus, koran, dan kantong kertas adalah sampah daur ulang bahan kertas.

items.prompt:
Read the final sentence of the factual recount about the sea turtle rescue in Unit 2 Section 4:
"The straw incident proved how dangerous plastic was to animals in the oceans."

What role does this sentence play in the structure of a factual recount text?
options: It serves as the final comment/evaluation reflecting on the incident.
It serves as the initial orientation introducing the characters.
It serves as the first record of event in chronological order.
It serves as an interview question directed to the reader.

why.0: Kalimat tersebut memberikan evaluasi atau pendapat akhir (final comment/evaluation) yang menyimpulkan dampak dari peristiwa yang diceritakan.

distractorWhy.1: Orientasi awal berada di bagian awal teks dan mengenalkan latar tokoh, waktu, serta tempat.
distractorWhy.2: Record of events memuat urutan aksi atau tindakan kronologis yang terjadi dalam peristiwa.
distractorWhy.3: Kalimat tersebut merupakan kalimat pernyataan evaluatif, bukan kalimat tanya wawancara.

competencies.name: Chapter 5: Embrace Yourself
competencies.materi: Describing Feelings and Personality Traits, Personal Recount Text, Self-Acceptance & Empathy, Encouraging Expressions
competencies.cpRef: English for Nusantara untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VII — Chapter 5 (Kelas VIII)

items.prompt:
Read the conversation from Unit 1 (p. 239):
Monita: "Pipit, look at these models!"
Pipit: "They are white and tall. They have no flaws at all. They are so beautiful. Should we put on makeup?"
Monita: "I think so. That's what makes them beautiful."

What is the main topic of Monita and Pipit's discussion?
options: Beauty standards and advertisements
Types of physical exercise
School sports competition
Cooking healthy meals

why.0: Monita dan Pipit sedang mendiskusikan iklan perawatan kecantikan dan standar kecantikan model yang sempurna tanpa cela.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini membahas olahraga fisik yang tidak disebutkan dalam percakapan.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini membahas kompetisi olahraga sekolah yang tidak relevan dengan dialog.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai memasak makanan sehat yang tidak sesuai dengan isi dialog.

items.prompt:
Read Kak Shinta's response in Unit 1 (p. 240):
Kak Shinta: "You know, we are beautiful just the way we are, with or without makeup."

What message is Kak Shinta conveying to Monita and Pipit?
options: Self-acceptance and loving oneself naturally
The mandatory requirement to wear cosmetics daily
The importance of saving money to buy expensive makeup
Becoming professional fashion models in the future

why.0: Kak Shinta menekankan penerimaan diri (self-acceptance) bahwa setiap individu cantik apa adanya tanpa perlu bergantung pada tata rias.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini bertolak belakang karena Kak Shinta tidak mewajibkan kosmetik.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini membahas tabungan kosmetik mahal yang tidak disampaikan Kak Shinta.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai cita-cita menjadi model yang tidak relevan dengan pesan Kak Shinta.

items.prompt: In Unit 1 (p. 241), match the word 'intently' with its correct meaning provided in Section 3:
options: With earnest and eager attention
A quick look or glance
A slight hollow in a hard surface
Cosmetics applied to the face

why.0: Sesuai dengan padanan kosakata di Section 3 (p. 241), 'intently' bermakna menatap dengan penuh perhatian dan sungguh-sungguh.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini merupakan definisi dari 'a glance'.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini merupakan definisi dari 'dent'.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini merupakan definisi dari 'makeup'.

items.prompt:
Read the story text from Unit 1 (p. 242):
"'You'd look prettier with makeup on.' She looked at me intently; her eyes were scanning every inch of my face. Every dent, every scratch, every line. Every flaw. Suddenly, all the words I had made friends with throughout my life vanished. I didn't say anything to her for a solid minute..."

How did the main character ('I') feel when her classmate made that comment?
options: Hurt and speechless
Cheered and excited
Amused and cheerful
Proud and confident

why.0: Karakter 'I' merasa tersakiti perasaannya dan tidak mampu berkata-kata (speechless) selama satu menit penuh akibat komentar tersebut.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini menggambarkan perasaan gembira yang berlawanan dengan konteks narasi.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menggambarkan rasa terhibur yang tidak sesuai dengan dampak emosional cerita.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menggambarkan rasa bangga dan percaya diri yang bertentangan dengan isi teks.

items.prompt:
Read the ending of the narrative in Unit 1 (p. 242):
"Maybe someday I'll carefully conceal my dents, my scratches, my lines. Maybe someday I'll 'prettify' my face. Maybe someday, but for now, I'll learn how to embrace every imperfection, flaw, and part of me..."

What resolution does the narrator reach at the end of the story?
options: Learning to embrace every flaw and imperfection
Buying whitening skin products immediately
Avoiding going to school forever
Confronting her classmate aggressively

why.0: Narator memutuskan untuk belajar merangkul dan menerima setiap kekurangan serta ketidaksempurnaan dirinya (embracing imperfection).

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini mengenai membeli produk pemutih yang tidak menjadi keputusan narator.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini mengenai membolos sekolah yang tidak disebutkan dalam teks.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai konfrontasi agresif yang tidak dilakukan oleh narator.

items.prompt: Based on Table 5.1 Language Focus (p. 244), which of the following expressions is used to express personal opinion with 'I'?
options: I think (that) ...
Once upon a time ...
The next morning ...
Suddenly ...

why.0: 'I think (that)...' adalah salah satu ungkapan standar untuk menyampaikan pendapat pribadi (expressing opinion).

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini merupakan kosa kata pembuka cerita naratif/dongeng.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini merupakan penanda urutan waktu (adverbial of time).
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini merupakan kata keterangan urutan peristiwa mendadak.

items.prompt:
Complete the opinion sentence based on Table 5.2 & 5.3 (p. 245):
"________, swimming helps you to stay healthy."
Which expression correctly completes the opinion statement?
options: In my opinion
Look at me
Long ago
Behind the door

why.0: 'In my opinion' merupakan frasa resmi yang digunakan untuk menyatakan pandangan/pendapat.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini merupakan kalimat perintah untuk melihat.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini merupakan keterangan waktu lampau.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini merupakan keterangan tempat.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue in Unit 2 (p. 255):
Galang: "I was in the same situation once. I thought I was not good at anything."
Monita: "But, I found out that I was good at playing basketball."
Made: "In my case, I thought I was not good at fishing but Galang proved me wrong. He taught me how to fish well. Thanks, Galang."

What role did Galang play in helping Made build self-confidence?
options: He patiently taught Made how to fish well
He bought new fishing gear for Made
He teased Made for lacking sports skills
He forced Made to join the basketball team

why.0: Galang membantu Made membuktikan bahwa anggapan dirinya buruk dalam memancing adalah keliru dengan mengajarinya teknik memancing yang baik.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini membahas membelikan alat pancing baru yang tidak ada dalam dialog.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini membahas mengejek Made yang bertolak belakang dengan sikap suportif Galang.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai memaksa masuk tim basket yang tidak sesuai dengan dialog.

items.prompt:
Read Part 1 of Mirza's story in Unit 2 (p. 257):
"While everyone was so eager to defend and score, Mirza was not sure about his role as a keeper. He ran left, then to the right, clumsily leaving the goal area empty. The next thing he knew, the other team already scored."

Why did the opposing team manage to score easily?
options: Mirza moved clumsily and left the goal area empty
The soccer ball broke in the middle of the game
Siti played as the goalkeeper for Mirza's team
The referee stopped the match unexpectedly

why.0: Tim lawan berhasil mencetak gol karena Mirza merasa canggung dan meninggalkan area gawang dalam keadaan kosong.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini mengenai bola plastik yang rusak yang tidak disebutkan saat pertandingan.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini keliru karena Siti bermain di pos penyerang/pemain depan.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai wasit menghentikan pertandingan yang tidak ada dalam teks.

items.prompt:
Read the conversation after the street soccer match in Unit 2 (p. 257):
Siti: "You were no use, Mirza. You can't play football."
Bayu: "I think he guarded the goal area well."
Siti: "But he didn't know what to do in the game. He was just running here and there."

How did Mirza react to Siti's discouraging harsh words?
options: He kept silent and remained calm without arguing
He shouted angrily at Siti and Bayu
He cried out loud and ran away immediately
He quit school soccer activities on the spot

why.0: Mirza memilih diam (kept silent) dan tidak membalas ucapan tajam Siti tersebut.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini berlawanan dengan fakta bahwa Mirza memilih untuk diam.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menyatakan Mirza menangis keras yang tidak tercantum dalam narasi.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai keluar sekolah yang tidak sesuai dengan alur cerita.

items.prompt:
Read Part 2 of Mirza's story in Unit 2 (p. 259):
Mirza asked his mother if he could join Winners Football Club, but his mother whispered, "But you know our financial condition." Then she suggested, "There's a community football club here. I heard Pak RT was looking for children to join the club."

Why could Mirza not join Winners Football Club?
options: His family had financial constraints to pay for the club
Pak RT banned Mirza from joining soccer clubs
Winners Football Club moved to another country
Mirza did not like soccer training at all

why.0: Mirza tidak dapat bergabung dengan Winners Football Club karena keterbatasan biaya keluarga (financial condition).

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini menyalahkan Pak RT padahal Pak RT justru memfasilitasi klub komunitas gratis.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini mengenai klub pindah negara yang tidak ada dalam konteks.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menyatakan Mirza tidak suka sepak bola padahal ia sangat ingin berlatih.

items.prompt:
Read Part 3 of Mirza's story in Unit 2 (p. 261):
"Pak RT came to him and suggested that he should try other positions. After trying some positions, he found that being a midfielder was the best position for him. A month later... He helped his team to win as a midfielder."

What key change led to Mirza's success in football?
options: Switching his position from goalkeeper to midfielder based on advice
Quitting the community soccer club to join a commercial academy
Refusing to pass the soccer ball to any of his teammates
Playing without a coach or any formal practice

why.0: Kunci keberhasilan Mirza adalah berpindah posisi dari penjaga gawang menjadi gelandang (midfielder) atas saran Pak RT.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini bertolak belakang dengan fakta bahwa Mirza berlatih di klub komunitas Pak RT.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menyatakan tidak mau mengoper bola padahal umpan presisi Mirza membantu Siti mencetak gol.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menyatakan bermain tanpa pelatih yang tidak sesuai cerita.

items.prompt:
Read Siti's words at the end of Unit 2 (p. 261):
Siti: "I'm sorry for underestimating you, Mirza. I should not have pushed you to be a goalkeeper. You are such a great midfielder!"
Mirza: "That's okay. Let's practice together to become a better team."

What personal quality does Mirza show when responding to Siti's apology?
options: Forgiveness and a supportive team spirit
Arrogance and holding long-term grudges
Indifference and lack of respect
Selfishness and boasting about his talent

why.0: Mirza menunjukkan kebesaran hati untuk memaafkan (forgiveness) dan semangat kerja sama tim (team spirit) tanpa menyimpan dendam.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini menggambarkan kesombongan dan dendam yang bertentangan dengan respon Mirza.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menggambarkan sikap acuh tak acuh yang tidak sesuai dengan ajakan Mirza.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menggambarkan rasa egois dan pamer yang bertolak belakang dengan karakter Mirza.

items.prompt: Based on Language Focus in Unit 2 (p. 265), identify the sentence that contains an adverb of manner ending in '-ly':
options: He ran left, then to the right, clumsily leaving the goal area empty.
Galang is always friendly to all of his classmates.
Andre sometimes feels lonely at home.
We have to respect elderly people in our neighborhood.

why.0: 'clumsily' adalah adverb of manner yang menerangkan bagaimana Mirza meninggalkan area gawang. Kata seperti friendly, lonely, dan elderly adalah adjective.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini menggunakan kata 'friendly' yang berkategori kata sifat (adjective).
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menggunakan kata 'lonely' yang berkategori kata sifat (adjective).
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menggunakan kata 'elderly' yang berkategori kata sifat (adjective).

items.prompt: Based on Language Focus in Unit 2 (p. 265), which of the following words is an adverb of manner that DOES NOT end in '-ly'?
options: well
clumsily
sternly
hesitantly

why.0: Kata 'well' merupakan contoh adverb of manner bentuk tidak berakhiran '-ly' (berasal dari kata sifat 'good').

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini adalah adverb of manner yang berakhiran '-ly'.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini adalah adverb of manner yang berakhiran '-ly'.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini adalah adverb of manner yang berakhiran '-ly'.

items.prompt:
Complete the sentence in Worksheet 5.12 (p. 267) using the correct adjective and adverb of manner:
"Mirza is a ________ soccer player. He plays soccer very ________."
options: good ; well
well ; good
good ; goodly
well ; well

why.0: 'good' digunakan sebagai kata sifat (adjective) menerangkan kata benda 'soccer player', sedangkan 'well' digunakan sebagai kata keterangan (adverb of manner) menerangkan kata kerja 'plays'.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini terbalik dalam penempatan kata sifat dan kata keterangan.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini salah karena bentuk 'goodly' tidak tepat digunakan sebagai keterangan cara bermain.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini menggunakan kata keterangan di posisi kata sifat.

items.prompt:
Read the story 'Getting into the Band' in Unit 3 (p. 274):
"I did a few auditions. The first time was a disaster. I couldn't get my breath and I started to cry. I just wanted to run home but the leader was very understanding. He fixed an appointment for the following week. He explained how to relax and do breathing techniques."

How did the band leader show empathy toward Peter during his failed first audition?
options: By giving breathing techniques and offering a re-audition
By disqualifying Peter from music activities permanently
By laughing at Peter's nervousness in front of everyone
By ordering Peter to leave the town hall immediately

why.0: Pemimpin grup musik menunjukkan empati dengan memahami kondisi Peter, mengajarkan teknik pernapasan/relaksasi, serta memberikan kesempatan audisi ulang.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini mengenai diskualifikasi permanen yang bertentangan dengan sikap suportif sang pemimpin.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini mengenai mengetawai kegugupan yang berlawanan dengan empati sang pemimpin.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengenai mengusir Peter yang tidak sesuai dengan isi narasi.

items.prompt:
Read the progression of Peter's auditions in Unit 3 (p. 274):
"The next time I had prepared everything. But, I did not play well enough because I was still nervous... The third time was a completely different story. I enjoyed it."

What key takeaway does Peter's story demonstrate regarding skill development?
options: Continuous practice and perseverance overcome initial anxiety
Relying on luck without preparation is sufficient for success
Giving up immediately after the first failure avoids stress
Natural talent requires no practice or breathing guidance

why.0: Pengalaman Peter membuktikan bahwa latihan tekun (practice) dan pantang menyerah (perseverance) mampu mengatasi kecemasan hingga meraih keberhasilan.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini mengandalkan keberuntungan semata yang bertolak belakang dengan usaha Peter.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini menyarankan menyerah pada kegagalan pertama yang bertentangan dengan semangat Peter.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini mengklaim bakat tidak butuh latihan yang berlawanan dengan judul bab 'Practice Makes Perfect'.

items.prompt:
Read Section 4 Language Focus on Narrative Text Structure in Unit 3 (p. 276):
Which generic structure of a personal recount narrative text functions to introduce the time, location, and characters of the story?
options: Orientation
Complication
Resolution
Re-orientation

why.0: 'Orientation' adalah bagian struktur naratif yang berfungsi mengenalkan tokoh, waktu, dan tempat terjadinya peristiwa.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini merupakan bagian yang menyajikan konflik atau permasalahan dalam cerita.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini merupakan bagian penyelesaian masalah.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini merupakan bagian penutup atau penyimpulan cerita.

items.prompt: Based on the text elements in Unit 3 (p. 276), what section of the narrative presents the solution to the conflict experienced by the characters?
options: Resolution
Complication
Orientation
Identification

why.0: 'Resolution' memuat solusi atau penyelesaian dari konflik (complication) yang dialami para tokoh.

distractorWhy.1: Pilihan ini adalah bagian munculnya konflik/masalah.
distractorWhy.2: Pilihan ini adalah bagian pengenalan latar dan tokoh.
distractorWhy.3: Pilihan ini adalah struktur umum teks deskriptif, bukan naratif.

competencies.name: Chapter 1: Exploring Fauna of Indonesia
competencies.materi: Reading Report Texts on Indonesian Wildlife (Bekantan, Orangutan, Birds), Passive Voice in Science Context, Describing Animals Physical & Behavior

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet from Comic Strip 1.1:
"Monita: Bekantan is a Proboscis monkey. Its scientific name is Nasalis larvatus."
Based on the conversation in Unit 1, what does the common name 'Proboscis monkey' mean?
options: A long-nosed monkey
A reddish-brown ape
A tailless primate
A short-tailed lemur

why.0: Proboscis monkey secara harfiah merujuk pada monyet berhidung panjang (long-nosed monkey), sebagaimana dijelaskan Monita dalam percakapan di Unit 1.

distractorWhy.1: Monyet bekantan memang berbulu cokelat kemerahan, tetapi kata proboscis secara khusus merujuk pada bentuk hidungnya yang panjang, bukan warna bulunya.
distractorWhy.2: Bekantan memiliki ekor yang hampir sama panjang dengan tubuhnya, sehingga bukan primata tanpa ekor.
distractorWhy.3: Bekantan tergolong primata jenis monyet berhidung panjang, bukan lemur berbuntut pendek.

items.prompt: In Comic Strip 1.2, Andre says: "Bekantans are grouped as arboreal animals." What is meant by arboreal animals based on the text explanation?
options: Animals that eat, sleep, and play mostly in trees
Animals that spend most of their time swimming in deep oceans
Animals that live exclusively inside dark underground caves
Animals that migrate across long distances during winter

why.0: Istilah arboreal dalam buku teks didefinisikan secara eksplisit sebagai hewan yang menghabiskan sebagian besar waktunya untuk makan, tidur, dan bermain di atas pohon.

distractorWhy.1: Hewan laut yang hidup di samudera tergolong akuatik, bukan arboreal.
distractorWhy.2: Hewan yang tinggal di dalam goa bawah tanah disebut hewan gua (troglobit), bukan arboreal.
distractorWhy.3: Hewan yang melakukan migrasi musiman tidak didefinisikan sebagai hewan arboreal atas dasar perilaku migrasinya.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet from Comic Strip 1.3:
"Monita: The book says that Bekantans can swim well because they have a skin membrane on their feet and hands like frogs."
Why do Bekantans need to swim according to the text in Unit 1?
options: To escape predators like crocodiles and cross rivers to find food
To clean their reddish-brown fur from dirt and parasites
To catch small marine fish in deep seawater habitats
To attract female mates by performing water dance routines

why.0: Bekantan berenang melintasi sungai untuk menyelamatkan diri dari pemangsa seperti buaya serta untuk mencari sumber makanan di seberang sungai.

distractorWhy.1: Tujuan utama bekantan berenang yang disebutkan dalam teks adalah menghindari pemangsa dan mencari makan, bukan untuk membersihkan bulu.
distractorWhy.2: Bekantan memakan dedaunan muda dan buah-buahan di hutan bakau, bukan berburu ikan laut di laut dalam.
distractorWhy.3: Bekantan menarik perhatian betina menggunakan hidungnya yang besar dan panjang, bukan dengan tarian air.

items.prompt:
Section 4 of Unit 1 explains Noun Groups: "A noun group is a group of words around a headword noun. Adjectives give more information before the noun."
Which sentence correctly uses a noun group to describe an animal's physical feature according to the pattern in Chapter 1?
options: The female Helmeted Hornbill has a bluish white featherless patch on its neck.
The female Helmeted Hornbill has a patch bluish white featherless on its neck.
The female Helmeted Hornbill featherless has patch a bluish white on its neck.
The female Helmeted Hornbill on its neck patch a bluish white featherless has.

why.0: Urutan frasa nomina (noun group) yang benar menempatkan kata sifat (bluish white, featherless) sebelum kata benda inti (patch), membentuk frasa a bluish white featherless patch.

distractorWhy.1: Kata sifat ditempatkan setelah kata benda sehingga struktur frasa nomina menjadi tidak tepat.
distractorWhy.2: Susunan kata sifat dan kata benda terpecah secara keliru di sekitar kata kerja.
distractorWhy.3: Tata kata acak ini merusak struktur frasa nomina dan tata bahasa kalimat.

items.prompt:
In Comic Strip 1.4, Monita explains the main danger facing Bekantans:
"The major threat is habitat destruction. It means they lose their home—their mangrove trees."
What is the main conclusion regarding how to save Bekantans?
options: People must save and protect the mangrove forests where Bekantans live
People should catch all Bekantans and move them to city zoos
People ought to feed Bekantans with commercial processed monkey food
People must eliminate all natural bird species in Borneo rainforests

why.0: Karena ancaman terbesar bagi bekantan adalah kerusakan habitat pohon bakau, cara utama menyelamatkannya adalah dengan menjaga dan melestarikan hutan bakau tersebut.

distractorWhy.1: Memindahkan seluruh populasi liar ke kebun binatang kota bukan solusi pelestarian habitat alami yang dimaksudkan dalam konteks teks.
distractorWhy.2: Memberi pakan buatan tidak mengatasi masalah hilangnya tempat tinggal alami mereka di hutan bakau.
distractorWhy.3: Membasmi spesies burung alami tidak relevan dan justru merusak ekosistem hutan Borneo.

items.prompt:
Read the informational text from 'Did you know?' in Unit 2:
"Apes and monkeys are two different animals. The first and easiest way to know the difference is by observing the absence or presence of their tails. Monkeys have tails while apes don't."
Based on this rule, which animal is categorized as an ape because it has no tail?
options: Orangutan
Proboscis monkey
Long-tailed macaque
Baboon

why.0: Orangutan tergolong kera (ape) karena tidak memiliki ekor dan bertubuh besar, sesuai penjelasan perbedaan kera dan monyet di Unit 2.

distractorWhy.1: Bekantan (Proboscis monkey) tergolong monyet karena memiliki ekor yang panjang.
distractorWhy.2: Macaca berkeor panjang merupakan jenis monyet karena jelas memiliki ekor.
distractorWhy.3: Babun merupakan spesies monyet yang memiliki ekor.

items.prompt:
According to the reading text 'Orangutan' in Unit 2:
"The scientific name of Orangutan from Northern Sumatra is Pongo abelii and the scientific name of Orangutan from Borneo is Pongo pygmaeus."
Which statement accurately reflects the facts provided in the report text?
options: Male orangutans can reach a height of up to 150 cm, whereas mature females average around 120 cm.
Female orangutans are heavier than male orangutans, weighing over 150 kg on average.
Orangutans live strictly in solitary desert areas without tree canopies.
Pongo pygmaeus is the scientific designation exclusive to Sumatran orangutans.

why.0: Teks menjelaskan bahwa orangutan jantan dapat mencapai tinggi 150 cm, sementara betina dewasa berukuran lebih kecil dengan tinggi sekitar 120 cm.

distractorWhy.1: Teks menyatakan orangutan jantan (bisa lebih dari 100 kg) jauh lebih berat daripada betina (sekitar 40 kg).
distractorWhy.2: Orangutan hidup di hutan hujan dan rawa di Sumatra dan Borneo di atas pepohonan, bukan di gurun pasir.
distractorWhy.3: Pongo pygmaeus adalah nama ilmiah untuk orangutan Borneo, sedangkan orangutan Sumatra bernama Pongo abelii.

items.prompt:
Study the rule in Unit 2 Language Focus:
"We use 'have' following a plural subject and 'has' following a singular subject to describe animal features."
Choose the correct pair of verbs to complete these sentences:
1) Gorillas ___ long arms.
2) Bekantan ___ a unique shape of nose.
options: have ; has
has ; have
have ; have
has ; has

why.0: Subjek jamak (Gorillas) menggunakan kata kerja have, sedangkan subjek tunggal (Bekantan) menggunakan kata kerja has.

distractorWhy.1: Penggunaan kata kerja terbalik untuk subjek jamak dan tunggal.
distractorWhy.2: Kata kerja have tidak tepat digunakan untuk subjek tunggal Bekantan.
distractorWhy.3: Kata kerja has tidak tepat digunakan untuk subjek jamak Gorillas.

items.prompt:
Examine the possessive adjective rules in Unit 2 Section 3:
"If the subject is singular, we add apostrophe+s ('s). If the subject is plural and ends with an 's', the possessive is formed by adding an apostrophe after the 's'."
Which sentence correctly applies this rule?
options: Orangutans and gorillas' legs are long, but a gorilla's fur is black.
Orangutans and gorillas's legs are long, but a gorillas' fur is black.
Orangutans's and gorilla's legs are long, but a gorilla' fur is black.
Orangutan and gorilla legs's are long, but a gorilla's fur is black.

why.0: Bentuk kepemilikan subjek jamak berakhiran s adalah gorillas', sedangkan subjek tunggal adalah gorilla's.

distractorWhy.1: Penambahan apostrof s setelah s jamak (gorillas's) dan penggunaan apostrof saja untuk kata tunggal (gorillas') melanggar aturan tata bahasa buku.
distractorWhy.2: Kata Orangutans's dan gorilla' tidak sesuai dengan aturan penulisan kepemilikan tunggal dan jamak.
distractorWhy.3: Penempatan tanda apostrof dan huruf s pada kata benda yang salah merusak struktur kepemilikan.

items.prompt:
Read the excerpt from Worksheet 1.15 ('Gorillas'):
"Gorillas are our closest cousins because they share 98.3% of their genetic code with humans... The group is led by a group leader called a silverback."
Why is the leader of a gorilla family group called a silverback?
options: The mature male leader develops silver-gray hair on his back as he ages
The leader carries a piece of silver metal found in African rain forests
The leader's skin reflects silver light during night time
The leader exclusively eats plants with silver-colored leaves

why.0: Pemimpin kelompok gorila jantan dewasa dinamakan silverback karena tumbuh bulu berwarna abu-abu keperakan di bagian punggungnya seiring bertambahnya usia.

distractorWhy.1: Istilah tersebut berkaitan dengan karakteristik fisik bulu gorila, bukan karena membawa benda logam.
distractorWhy.2: Kulit gorila berwarna hitam dan tidak memancarkan cahaya keperakan di malam hari.
distractorWhy.3: Gorila memakan dedaunan, tunas, dan batang tumbuhan biasa, bukan tumbuhan khusus berdaun perak.

items.prompt:
In Comic Strip 1.5, Galang and Andre discuss the Helmeted Hornbill:
"Andre: It is the only hornbill with a casque made of keratin.
Monita: What is a casque?
Andre: The bird's helmet."
What is the unique feature of the Helmeted Hornbill's casque mentioned in the text?
options: It is a solid helmet-like structure on its beak made of keratin
It is a soft leather pouch under its throat used to hold water
It is a pair of long tail streamers used for steering in flight
It is a colorful crest feather located on its wing tips

why.0: Casque adalah struktur mirip helm keras di atas paruh burung enggang gading yang terbuat dari zat tanduk (keratin).

distractorWhy.1: Casque berada di atas paruh dan bertekstur keras, bukan kantong kulit lunak di bawah tenggorokan.
distractorWhy.2: Bulu ekor yang panjang adalah fitur lain pada ekornya, bukan casque (helm).
distractorWhy.3: Casque berada di bagian kepala/paruh, bukan bulu jambul pada ujung sayap.

items.prompt:
According to Audio Transcript 2 in Unit 3:
"Males have a red featherless patch on the neck, while females have a bluish-white patch."
If a birder observes a Helmeted Hornbill in the forest with a bluish-white neck patch, what can be inferred?
options: The observed bird is a female Helmeted Hornbill
The observed bird is a male Helmeted Hornbill
The observed bird is a young chick that has not grown feathers
The observed bird belongs to the Cendrawasih family

why.0: Bercak kulit tanpa bulu berwarna putih kebiruan di bagian leher merupakan ciri khas burung enggang gading betina.

distractorWhy.1: Burung jantan memiliki bercak kulit berwarna merah di bagian lehernya.
distractorWhy.2: Warna kulit leher putih kebiruan membedakan jenis kelamin betina dewasa, bukan indikator anak burung.
distractorWhy.3: Ciri fisik leher ini milik spesies Helmeted Hornbill (Rhinoplax vigil), bukan burung Cendrawasih.

items.prompt:
Read the report text on Cendrawasih from Unit 3 Section 3:
"Cendrawasihs or the birds of paradise are from the family of Paradisaeidae... The natural devastation and illegal hunting make Cenderawasih an endangered species. Their reproduction cycle also makes the preservation difficult as they only produce one until two eggs."
What factors cause Cendrawasih to become endangered according to the text?
options: Natural devastation, illegal hunting, and a low reproduction rate of 1-2 eggs
High consumption of toxic ocean fish and cold polar climate changes
Attacks from silverback gorillas and overpopulation of predators
Rapid growth of commercial tree plantations in Western Australia

why.0: Kelangkaan Cendrawasih disebabkan oleh kerusakan alam, perburuan liar, serta siklus reproduksi yang lambat karena hanya bertelur 1 hingga 2 butir.

distractorWhy.1: Cendrawasih hidup di hutan Indonesia Timur dan memakan buah serta artropoda, bukan ikan laut beracun.
distractorWhy.2: Gorila hidup di Afrika dan tidak berinteraksi dengan burung Cendrawasih di Indonesia Timur.
distractorWhy.3: Perkebunan Australia Barat bukan faktor utama ancaman kelangkaan yang dijelaskan dalam teks.

items.prompt:
Section 4 of Unit 3 explains Passive Voice:
"When we talk about facts or events, we sometimes want to emphasize the action rather than who is doing the action. We use passive voice to show interest in the person or object that experiences an action."
Why do scientific report texts frequently use passive voice?
options: To focus on the animal or object experiencing the action rather than the doer
To make sentences longer and more difficult for readers to understand
To express personal emotional feelings and informal daily gossip
To hide factual information from scientific researchers

why.0: Kalimat pasif digunakan dalam teks laporan ilmiah untuk memberikan penekanan pada objek atau hewan yang dikenai tindakan, bukan pada pelakunya.

distractorWhy.1: Tujuan kalimat pasif bukan untuk memperrumit bacaan, melainkan menyampaikan fokus informasi ilmiah secara tepat.
distractorWhy.2: Teks laporan ilmiah bersifat objektif dan faktual, bukan untuk mengungkapkan perasaan emosional pribadi.
distractorWhy.3: Kalimat pasif digunakan untuk kejelasan fokus ilmiah, bukan untuk menyembunyikan fakta.

items.prompt:
Consider the grammar example from Unit 3 Section 4:
Active: "Galang brings binoculars to the forest." -> Passive: "Binoculars are brought by Galang to the forest."
Now, transform the active sentence below into passive voice following the rules in Chapter 1:
Active: "Monita reads a book about bekantan."
options: A book about bekantan is read by Monita.
A book about bekantan was reading by Monita.
Monita is read a book about bekantan.
A book about bekantan is reading Monita.

why.0: Objek A book about bekantan (tunggal) menjadi subjek pasif diikuti to be 'is' dan kata kerja bentuk ketiga 'read' (is read by Monita).

distractorWhy.1: Penggunaan bentuk was reading berubah menjadi kalimat lampau berlangsung (past continuous), bukan pasif sederhana.
distractorWhy.2: Menjadikan Monita sebagai pihak yang dibaca merusak makna kalimat secara logis.
distractorWhy.3: Penggunaan kata kerja aktif is reading membuat buku seolah-olah membaca Monita.

items.prompt:
Choose the correct passive verb forms to complete the sentences below based on Worksheet 1.21 in Unit 3:
1) Bekantan is ___ (find/found) in Kalimantan.
2) The leaves are ___ (eat/eaten) by Bekantans.
3) Water is ___ (drink/drunk) from holes between tree branches by orangutans.
options: found ; eaten ; drunk
find ; eat ; drink
finding ; eating ; drinking
founded ; eated ; dranked

why.0: Kalimat pasif dalam bahasa Inggris menggunakan kata kerja bentuk ketiga (past participle): found, eaten, dan drunk.

distractorWhy.1: Bentuk kata kerja dasar (infinitive) tidak dapat digunakan setelah kata kerja bantu to be dalam struktur pasif.
distractorWhy.2: Bentuk present participle (-ing) membentuk kalimat aktif continuous, bukan kalimat pasif.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk kata kerja tidak beraturan yang salah tata bahasanya (founded, eated, dranked).

items.prompt:
Read the informational excerpt from Unit 3 Section 4 ('Did you know?'):
"What is bird watching exactly? It is an activity where birds are observed for the purpose of recreation or science. People who like birdwatching are called birders."
What activities do birders do during bird watching according to the text?
options: Observe birds' appearance and behavior, take notes, identify species, and share findings
Catch wild birds with nets and sell them at traditional animal markets
Shoot birds using slingshots for recreational outdoor sport competition
Train wild birds to perform acrobatic tricks in public entertainment shows

why.0: Para pengamat burung (birders) melakukan pengamatan penampilan dan perilaku burung, mencatat, mengidentifikasi spesies, serta membagikan temuan mereka.

distractorWhy.1: Kegiatan pengamatan burung bersifat rekreasi dan ilmiah, bukan penangkapan untuk dijual di pasar.
distractorWhy.2: Birdwatching tidak melibatkan perburuan atau penembakan burung.
distractorWhy.3: Pengamatan burung tidak bertujuan melatih burung liar untuk pertunjukan sirkus.

items.prompt:
Study the five steps of writing a report text outlined in Unit 3 Section 5:
1. Gathering Information
2. Organizing Information
3. Writing the draft
4. Revising and Editing the draft
5. Publishing your work
Which step involves 'collecting information by reading references and making observations'?
options: Gathering Information
Revising and Editing the draft
Publishing your work
Organizing Information

why.0: Tahap Gathering Information (Pengumpulan Informasi) adalah langkah awal di mana penulis mengumpulkan data melalui membaca referensi dan pengamatan langsung.

distractorWhy.1: Tahap revisi dan penyuntingan dilakukan setelah draf awal selesai ditulis untuk memperbaiki tata bahasa dan isi.
distractorWhy.2: Tahap publikasi adalah langkah akhir membagikan hasil laporan kepada guru atau media.
distractorWhy.3: Pengorganisasian informasi adalah tahap mengelompokkan data yang telah dikumpulkan ke dalam kategori yang sesuai.

items.prompt:
Section 6 presents a fact sheet about the Bali Starling (Jalak Bali):
- Threats: Poaching for illegal songbird trade, habitat loss
- Lifespan: 5 years in the wild, up to 15 years in captivity
- Interesting fact: The national bird of Bali, saved by breeding and reintroduction programmes.
Which passive sentence best represents the fact about saving the Bali Starling from extinction?
options: Bali starlings were saved from extinction by breeding and reintroduction programmes.
Illegal songbird traders saved Bali starlings from habitat loss.
Bali starlings are being hunted to increase their population in captivity.
Programmers saved Bali starlings by building digital computer games.

why.0: Kalimat pasif ini secara akurat menyampaikan fakta bahwa jalak bali diselamatkan dari kepunahan melalui program penangkaran dan pelepasliaran kembali.

distractorWhy.1: Pedagang burung berkicau ilegal adalah ancaman kelangsungan hidup jalak bali, bukan pihak yang menyelamatkannya.
distractorWhy.2: Perburuan liar mengurangi populasi jalak bali, bukan meningkatkan populasinya.
distractorWhy.3: Program yang dimaksud adalah penangkaran biologi (breeding), bukan pemrograman komputer digital.

items.prompt:
Across Chapter 1, students learn to read and write Report Texts on Indonesian fauna (Bekantan, Orangutan, Birds).
What is the main social function and generic structure of a Report Text based on Chapter 1?
options: To present factual information about natural phenomena or animals in general, typically structured with General Classification followed by Descriptions
To entertain readers with a fictional fairy tale about talking animals, structured with Orientation, Complication, and Resolution
To persuade readers to buy exotic pets, structured with Thesis, Arguments, and Recommendation
To instruct readers on how to cook traditional Indonesian dishes, structured with Goal, Materials, and Steps

why.0: Teks laporan (Report Text) berfungsi menyajikan informasi faktual umum tentang hewan atau fenomena alam, dengan struktur Umum (General Classification) dan Deskripsi (Descriptions).

distractorWhy.1: Struktur Orientation, Complication, Resolution milik Teks Naratif (Narrative Text) yang bertujuan menghibur dengan cerita fiktif.
distractorWhy.2: Struktur Thesis, Arguments, Recommendation milik Teks Eksposisi yang bertujuan membujuk pembaca.
distractorWhy.3: Struktur Goal, Materials, Steps milik Teks Prosedur (Procedure Text) yang memberikan petunjuk langkah demi langkah.

competencies.name: Chapter 2: Taking Care of Yourself
competencies.materi: Giving Advice & Suggestions (should/shouldn't), Expressing Agreement & Disagreement, Healthy Habits & Mental Health
competencies.cpRef: English for Nusantara untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VII — Chapter 2 (Kelas IX)

items.prompt:
Read the following text snippet about daily healthy routines:
"Teenagers undergo rapid physical and mental growth. To support their active school life and body development, health experts recommend that teenagers get around 8 to 10 hours of quality sleep every night."
Based on the text, what is the recommended amount of sleep for teenagers every night?
options: Getting 8 to 10 hours of quality sleep every night
Sleeping for only 4 to 5 hours on school days
Staying awake until midnight and sleeping 12 hours on weekends
Sleeping intermittently for 2 hours throughout the day

why.0: Teks secara jelas menyebutkan bahwa remaja membutuhkan tidur berkualitas selama 8 hingga 10 jam setiap malam untuk mendukung pertumbuhan fisik dan mental.

distractorWhy.1: Tidur selama 4 hingga 5 jam terlalu singkat dan dapat membahayakan kesehatan serta fokus belajar remaja.
distractorWhy.2: Pola tidur tidak teratur dengan mengganti waktu tidur di akhir pekan tidak disarankan untuk menjaga ritme sirkadian tubuh.
distractorWhy.3: Tidur terputus-putus selama 2 jam tidak memberikan fase tidur lelap yang cukup bagi pemulihan tubuh.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet between Monita and Pipit:
Monita: "Pipit, don't forget to wash your hands before eating your lunch!"
Pipit: "Sure! How should I wash my hands properly?"
Monita: "You should wash your hands with soap and clean running water for at least 20 seconds."
What is Monita's advice regarding proper hand hygiene?
options: Wash hands with soap and running water for at least 20 seconds
Rinse hands with warm water without using any soap
Wipe hands using a dry tissue paper before eating
Dip hands into a bowl of stagnant water quickly

why.0: Saran Monita sesuai percakapan adalah mencuci tangan menggunakan sabun dan air mengalir minimal selama 20 detik.

distractorWhy.1: Membilas dengan air hangat tanpa sabun tidak efektif membunuh kuman dan bakteri pada tangan.
distractorWhy.2: Mengelap tangan dengan tisu kering hanya membersihkan kotoran kasat mata, bukan kuman penyakit.
distractorWhy.3: Mencelupkan tangan ke air tenang dapat memindahkan kuman dari wadah ke tangan.

items.prompt:
Read the following scenario:
Galang just finished playing a heavy match of football on the school field. He feels sweaty, exhausted, and covered in dirt.
Which sentence expresses the most suitable advice using 'should' for Galang's hygiene?
options: He should take a bath and change into clean dry clothes
He should continue wearing his dirty sports uniform all day
He should sleep on his bed immediately without washing
He should eat heavy fried food before washing his hands

why.0: Ungkapan saran yang tepat setelah berolahraga dan berkeringat adalah mandi serta mengganti pakaian yang bersih dan kering.

distractorWhy.1: Memakai seragam olahraga yang kotor dan berkeringat sepanjang hari dapat menyebabkan iritasi kulit dan bau badan.
distractorWhy.2: Langsung tidur tanpa membersihkan badan membuat kotoran dan keringat menempel di tempat tidur.
distractorWhy.3: Makan makanan berminyak tanpa mencuci tangan dapat menimbulkan masalah pencernaan akibat kuman.

items.prompt:
Read the text snippet on body hydration:
"Water plays a crucial role in maintaining body temperature, flushing out toxins, and keeping our concentration high. Drinking at least eight glasses of clean water daily helps prevent dehydration during physical school activities."
Why is drinking enough water essential for students?
options: To keep the body hydrated and maintain optimal concentration
To replace the main intake of solid nutritious meals
To increase sugar levels in the blood before taking tests
To slow down the heart rate while doing morning sports

why.0: Teks menjelaskan bahwa minum air yang cukup menjaga hidrasi tubuh, membantu membuang racun, dan menjaga konsentrasi belajar.

distractorWhy.1: Air minum tidak menggantikan asupan makanan bergizi seimbang yang dibutuhkan tubuh.
distractorWhy.2: Air putih tidak mengandung gula sehingga tidak berfungsi menaikkan kadar gula darah secara drastis.
distractorWhy.3: Tujuan utama minum air adalah mencegah dehidrasi, bukan memperlambat detak jantung saat berolahraga.

items.prompt:
Read the text on personal dental care:
"Tooth decay is often caused by food particles and bacteria left on teeth after meals. Dentists suggest brushing teeth twice a day—once after breakfast and once before going to bed at night—to maintain healthy teeth and fresh breath."
Based on the text, what is the recommended dental care routine?
options: Brushing teeth twice daily, after breakfast and before bedtime
Brushing teeth only when experiencing severe toothache
Rinsing the mouth with sweet syrup after every meal
Brushing teeth once a week using hard metal scrapers

why.0: Rekomendasi perawatan gigi yang benar adalah menyikat gigi dua kali sehari, yaitu setelah sarapan dan sebelum tidur malam.

distractorWhy.1: Menyikat gigi hanya saat sakit gigi sudah terlambat untuk memelihara kesehatan gigi.
distractorWhy.2: Berkumur dengan sirup manis justru meninggalkan gula yang mempercepat kerusakan gigi oleh bakteri.
distractorWhy.3: Menyikat gigi seminggu sekali tidak cukup dan penggunaan pengikis logam keras berisiko merusak lapisan email gigi.

items.prompt:
Read the short story excerpt:

How can Andre's emotional state be best described?
options: Anxious and stressed about his upcoming presentation
Delighted and cheerful about meeting his friends
Bored and uninterested in the school activity
Calm and completely relaxed about the exam

why.0: Ciri-ciri fisik seperti jantung berdebar cepat, tangan berkeringat, dan rasa khawatir menunjukkan kondisi cemas dan stres.

distractorWhy.1: Rasa gembira ditandai dengan perasaan senang dan ceria, bukan kekhawatiran berlebih.
distractorWhy.2: Rasa bosan ditandai dengan kurangnya perhatian atau rasa jenuh, bukan kecemasan fisik.
distractorWhy.3: Kondisi tenang ditandai dengan pikiran rileks dan denyut jantung yang stabil.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue between Monita and Andre:
Monita: "Andre, you look so exhausted and stressed. Have you been studying all night?"
Andre: "Yes, I stayed up until 3 AM reading all the textbook units."
Monita: "________."

options: You should take short rest breaks and manage your study time better
You should stay up even later until the morning exam starts
You should skip the examination and stay in bed all week
You should stop studying English completely from now on

why.0: Saran yang sehat untuk mengatasi kelelahan akibat belajar berlebihan adalah mengambil istirahat sejenak dan mengatur waktu belajar dengan lebih baik.

distractorWhy.1: Begadang lebih lama hingga pagi akan memperburuk kelelahan fisik dan menurunkan konsentrasi saat ujian.
distractorWhy.2: Membawa diri untuk membolos ujian bukan solusi bertanggung jawab atas kelelahan belajar.
distractorWhy.3: Berhenti belajar bahasa Inggris secara total merupakan tindakan ekstrem yang tidak memecahkan masalah.

items.prompt:
Read the text on mental health awareness:
"When teenagers feel overwhelmed by feelings of sadness or anxiety, keeping emotions bottled up can make things worse. Sharing worries with a trusted adult, counselor, or friend helps lighten the emotional burden."
According to the passage, what should students do when feeling emotionally overwhelmed?
options: Talk about their feelings with a counselor or trusted adult
Keep all negative feelings hidden inside without telling anyone
Blame their classmates for every emotional distress they feel
Avoid interacting with anyone and lock themselves in room forever

why.0: Teks menyarankan agar siswa membicarakan perasaan mereka kepada guru BK, orang tua, atau orang dewasa terpercaya untuk meringankan beban emosional.

distractorWhy.1: Memendam perasaan secara terus-menerus dapat memperburuk kondisi kesehatan mental.
distractorWhy.2: Menyalahkan teman tidak memecahkan akar masalah emosional yang sedang dihadapi.
distractorWhy.3: Mengisolasi diri secara permanen menghambat dukungan sosial yang dibutuhkan untuk pemulihan emosi.

items.prompt:
Read the following paragraph about digital wellness:
"Spending late hours staring at smartphone screens exposes the eyes to blue light, which suppresses melatonin production. As a result, teenagers often experience sleep disturbances, mood swings, and difficulty focusing during morning classes."
What is the main conclusion of the text regarding screen time before sleeping?
options: Excessive late-night screen time negatively impacts sleep quality and mood
Using smartphones at night guarantees better memory retention for exams
Blue light from screens helps the body produce more sleep hormones
Students should play mobile games right before going to bed every night

why.0: Kesimpulan utama teks adalah bahwa penggunaan gawai hingga larut malam berpotensi mengganggu kualitas tidur dan suasana hati remaja.

distractorWhy.1: Teks tidak pernah menyatakan bahwa penggunaan ponsel malam hari meningkatkan daya ingat.
distractorWhy.2: Cahaya biru dari layar justru menekan produksi hormon melatonin (hormon tidur), bukan menaikkannya.
distractorWhy.3: Bermain gim ponsel tepat sebelum tidur tidak disarankan karena merangsang aktivitas otak dan mengganggu tidur.

items.prompt:
Read the advice on building positive self-esteem:
"Everyone makes mistakes while learning a new language or skill. Instead of harsh self-criticism, practicing positive self-talk helps build self-confidence and mental resilience."
What action is encouraged to foster mental resilience?
options: Practicing positive self-talk and learning from mistakes
Comparing oneself constantly with others to feel superior
Giving up immediately whenever a mistake is made
Punishing oneself severely for small grammar errors

why.0: Teks mendorong praktik dialog diri yang positif (positive self-talk) dan belajar dari kesalahan untuk membangun ketahanan mental.

distractorWhy.1: Membandingkan diri secara terus-menerus dengan orang lain dapat memicu rasa iri dan menurunkan percaya diri.
distractorWhy.2: Langsung menyerah saat berbuat salah menghambat kemajuan belajar.
distractorWhy.3: Menghukum diri sendiri secara berlebihan dapat merusak kesehatan emosional.

items.prompt:
Read the infographic guidance on healthy nutrition:
"A balanced plate should contain carbohydrates for energy, proteins for muscle repair, vitamins from vegetables and fruits for immunity, and clean water for bodily functions."
Which item combination represents a balanced and healthy lunch menu?
options: Steamed rice, grilled fish, fresh spinach soup, and an apple
Instant noodles, fried potato chips, and a sweet soda drink
Double chocolate cake, ice cream, and sweet milk tea
Deep-fried snacks, candy bars, and energy drinks

why.0: Kombinasi nasi kukus, ikan bakar, sayur bayam, dan buah apel mencakup karbohidrat, protein, vitamin, dan serat yang seimbang.

distractorWhy.1: Mie instan, keripik kentang goreng, dan soda kaya akan gula dan garam serta minim serat dan gizi seimbang.
distractorWhy.2: Kue cokelat, es krim, dan teh manis mengandung kadar gula tinggi tanpa protein dan sayuran.
distractorWhy.3: Gorengan, permen, dan minuman berenergi mengandung lemak jenuh dan pemanis buatan berlebih.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet:
Galang: "I feel sluggish and sleepy every afternoon during class."
Pipit: "What do you usually eat for lunch at the canteen?"
Galang: "I eat three fried snacks and drink two cups of extra sweet iced tea."
Pipit: "Well, you ________ consume too much sugar and fried food if you want to stay energetic."
Which modal verb best completes Pipit's advice?
options: shouldn't
must
should
can

why.0: Kata 'shouldn't' (tidak seharusnya) digunakan untuk memberi saran agar tidak melakukan kebiasaan buruk mengonsumsi gula dan makanan berminyak berlebihan.

distractorWhy.1: 'must' menyatakan keharusan mutlak/aturan, bukan saran larangan kebiasaan makan.
distractorWhy.2: 'should' akan bermakna menyarankan untuk mengonsumsi makanan tidak sehat, yang bertentangan dengan konteks.
distractorWhy.3: 'can' menyatakan kemampuan atau izin, bukan saran perbaikan pola makan.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet between Monita and Pipit:
Monita: "Why did you go to the school clinic during the flag ceremony this morning?"
Pipit: "I felt dizzy because I rushed out of home without eating anything."
Monita: "Oh dear, you ________ eat a nutritious breakfast before school to keep your body strong."
Which modal verb correctly fills the blank to give a helpful suggestion?
options: should
shouldn't
might not
wouldn't

why.0: Kata 'should' (seharusnya) tepat digunakan untuk menyarankan tindakan positif yang bermanfaat, yaitu sarapan bergizi sebelum ke sekolah.

distractorWhy.1: 'shouldn't' membuat kalimat bermakna melarang sarapan, yang bertentangan dengan saran kesehatan.
distractorWhy.2: 'might not' menyatakan kemungkinan negatif, bukan ungkapan saran.
distractorWhy.3: 'wouldn't' menyatakan ketidakmauan di masa lalu/kondisional, bukan ungkapan saran.

items.prompt:
Read the conversation on healthy lifestyle choices:
Galang: "In my opinion, replacing sweet snacks with fresh fruits during break time gives us more natural energy."
Pipit: "________. I tried eating bananas yesterday and felt much more active during sports class."
Which expression best completes Pipit's statement to show strong agreement?
options: I completely agree with you
I'm afraid I have a different opinion
I totally disagree with your idea
I doubt that fruits contain any vitamins

why.0: Ungkapan 'I completely agree with you' (Saya sangat setuju denganmu) tepat digunakan karena Pipit mendukung pendapat Galang berdasarkan pengalamannya sendiri.

distractorWhy.1: 'I'm afraid I have a different opinion' digunakan untuk menyatakan ketidaksetujuan secara halus.
distractorWhy.2: 'I totally disagree with your idea' menyatakan ketidaksetujuan secara tegas.
distractorWhy.3: 'I doubt that...' menyatakan keraguan atas fakta kandungan buah.

items.prompt:
Read the dialogue snippet during a health discussion:
Andre: "Skipping dinner completely is the best and fastest way for teenagers to maintain a slim body."
Monita: "________. Teenagers still need balanced nutrients at night, but in smaller and healthier portions."
Which expression best fills the blank to express polite disagreement?
options: I don't think so
That's exactly what I think
You are absolutely right
I couldn't agree more

why.0: Ungkapan 'I don't think so' (Saya rasa tidak demikian) menunjukkan ketidaksetujuan yang santun terhadap gagasan melewatkan makan malam.

distractorWhy.1: 'That's exactly what I think' menyatakan persetujuan penuh terhadap pendapat Andre.
distractorWhy.2: 'You are absolutely right' menyatakan bahwa pendapat Andre sepenuhnya benar.
distractorWhy.3: 'I couldn't agree more' merupakan ungkapan persetujuan yang sangat kuat.

items.prompt:

Why are natural whole foods better than ultra-processed snacks?
options: They provide clean energy and essential dietary fiber without harmful additives
They contain higher levels of artificial colors and sodium
They spoil immediately within five seconds of opening
They cause rapid weight gain and high blood pressure

why.0: Makanan alami menyediakan energi bersih dan serat penting tanpa zat aditif berbahaya yang terdapat pada makanan olahan berlebih.

distractorWhy.1: Pewarna buatan dan kadar natrium tinggi adalah ciri makanan olahan berlebih, bukan makanan alami.
distractorWhy.2: Teks tidak menyebutkan bahwa makanan alami langsung basi dalam hitungan detik.
distractorWhy.3: Penyebab kenaikan berat badan drastis dan tekanan darah tinggi adalah konsumsi gorengan/makanan olahan bergaram tinggi.

items.prompt:

She should eat more chili sauce to cure the burning sensation

why.0: Saran medis yang tepat untuk sakit perut akibat makanan pedas adalah minum air hangat dan tidak mengonsumsi makanan sangat pedas lagi.

distractorWhy.1: Menambah konsumsi sambal akan memperparah iritasi lambung.
distractorWhy.2: Melarang beristirahat atau melaporkan rasa sakit dapat membahayakan keselamatan siswa.
distractorWhy.3: Minuman bersoda dingin berkarbonasi dapat memicu peningkatan asam lambung dan memperburuk rasa nyeri.

items.prompt:
Read the discussion excerpt:
Galang: "Our school canteen should stop selling all fried snacks starting tomorrow."
Monita: "That's a good point, but ________. We should introduce healthy food choices gradually so students can adapt."
Which option completes Monita's response to express a partial agreement with a constructive suggestion?
options: a complete sudden ban might be difficult for everyone right away
fried snacks are the healthiest food available on earth
canteen sellers should be closed down permanently
nobody in school cares about healthy food choices

why.0: Monita menyetujui tujuan Galang tetapi memberikan masukan konstruktif bahwa larangan mendadak secara total bisa menyulitkan, sehingga transisi bertahap lebih realistis.

distractorWhy.1: Menyatakan gorengan makanan tersehat bertentangan dengan prinsip kesehatan dalam teks.
distractorWhy.2: Menutup kantin secara permanen adalah tindakan ekstrem yang tidak relevan dengan diskusi pilihan menu.
distractorWhy.3: Menyatakan tidak ada yang peduli merupakan prasangka negatif yang tidak membimbing.

items.prompt: Which of the following sentences correctly combines the advice structure using 'should' and 'shouldn't' to promote good personal health habits?
options: You should eat fresh vegetables every day, and you shouldn't stay up late every night.
You shouldn't eat fresh vegetables every day, and you should stay up late every night.
You should eating fresh vegetables every day, and you shouldn't to stay up late every night.
You should to eat fresh vegetables every day, and you shouldn't staying up late every night.

why.0: Kalimat ini secara tata bahasa benar (menggunakan modal 'should/shouldn't' + bare infinitive 'eat' dan 'stay') dan bermakna tepat untuk kesehatan.

distractorWhy.1: Makna kalimat terbalik: melarang makan sayur dan menyuruh begadang tiap malam.
distractorWhy.2: Penggunaan bentuk '-ing' ('should eating') dan 'to infinitive' setelah modal 'shouldn't' ('shouldn't to stay') secara tata bahasa salah.
distractorWhy.3: Penggunaan 'to infinitive' ('should to eat') dan bentuk '-ing' ('shouldn't staying') secara tata bahasa salah.

items.prompt:
Read the summary passage of Chapter 2 ("Taking Care of Yourself"):
"Taking care of oneself involves a holistic approach. It requires maintaining personal physical hygiene, eating nutritious balanced meals, engaging in physical activities, getting sufficient rest, and taking care of one's mental health through positive social interactions and emotional expression."

Focusing exclusively on physical appearance while ignoring mental stress
Relying solely on medicine without changing daily lifestyle habits
Exercising continuously for 10 hours a day without taking any break

distractorWhy.1: Hanya berfokus pada penampilan fisik tanpa memedulikan stres mental bukan pendekatan holistik yang sehat.
