items.prompt: In Chapter 3 Unit 1 ("Andre and Princess Suripit"), Andre suddenly finds himself sucked into his mobile game in the Mangrovian Kingdom. What outfit is Andre wearing when he arrives in Mangrovian?
options: A metal breastplate and gauntlets (a knight outfit)
His comfortable pajamas from home
A school uniform from SMP Merdeka
A royal cloak and golden crown

why.0: Based on Audio 3.2 text in Unit 1, Andre realizes he is no longer wearing his pajamas. Instead, he wears a metal breastplate and gauntlets on his hands, which is a knight outfit.

distractorWhy.1: Andre was wearing pajamas before being sucked into the game, but upon arrival in Mangrovian, his outfit changed to a knight outfit.
distractorWhy.2: The school uniform of SMP Merdeka is related to Monita in Unit 2, not Andre in Unit 1.
distractorWhy.3: Princess Suripit is the guardian of the Mangrovian Kingdom, whereas Andre is equipped as a knight with plate armor, not royal cloaks.

items.prompt: In Unit 1 ("Andre and Princess Suripit"), Princess Suripit informs Andre about his final mission in order to return to his world. What is Andre's main mission?
options: To find the endangered black orchid
To defeat the giant monster in the factory
To build a time travel car with red buttons
To collect three magical items from a golden cucumber

why.0: According to Audio 3.3 in Unit 1 Section 4, Princess Suripit states that Andre can only go home after completing his final mission, which is to find the endangered black orchid.

distractorWhy.1: Defeating a giant factory owner is related to the multiverse story of Timun Mas in Unit 3, not Andre's mission in Unit 1.
distractorWhy.2: Building a time travel car is part of Monita's story in Unit 2, not Andre's mission in Unit 1.
distractorWhy.3: Collecting magical items from a golden cucumber refers to Timun Mas's story in Unit 3.

items.prompt: Read the explanatory note on plate armor from Unit 1 Section 4: "Plate armor is body armor made of iron or steel plates. Knights used plate armor to protect them from sword slashes and spears when they were on the battlefield." Why did knights wear plate armor?
options: To protect themselves from sword slashes and spears during battle
To make themselves fly faster in mobile games
To keep themselves warm during cold nights in the forest
To disguise themselves as ordinary villagers

why.0: The text explicitly states that knights used plate armor made of iron or steel plates to protect themselves from sword slashes and spears on the battlefield.

distractorWhy.1: Plate armor is heavy (over 20 kg) and does not grant flying abilities.
distractorWhy.2: Plate armor was designed for combat protection on the battlefield, not for temperature regulation.
distractorWhy.3: Plate armor is distinct knight attire and would not serve as a civilian disguise.

items.prompt: In Unit 1 Section 3 ("Language Focus: Was and Were"), we use "was" with singular subjects and "were" with plural subjects to describe past situations. Which sentence correctly follows this rule?
options: There were gauntlets on his hands and the armor was made of metal.
There was gauntlets on his hands and the armor were made of metal.
There were a strange message from the game.
Andre were amazed to see the Mangrovian kingdom.

why.0: "Gauntlets" is plural so it takes "were" ("There were gauntlets"), while "armor" is singular so it takes "was" ("the armor was made of metal").

distractorWhy.1: "Gauntlets" is plural and requires "were", while "armor" is singular and requires "was".
distractorWhy.2: "A strange message" is singular, so it requires "was" ("There was a strange message") rather than "were".
distractorWhy.3: "Andre" is a singular proper noun, so it requires "was" ("Andre was amazed") rather than "were".

items.prompt: In Worksheet 3.4 (Unit 1), students complete sentences about past states. Choose the correct form of to be (was/were) for the sentence: "Andre ___ amazed to see Mangrovian kingdom because Andre's armor ___ shiny."
options: was / was
were / were
was / were
were / was

why.0: Both "Andre" and "Andre's armor" are singular subjects, so both blanks require the singular past form "was".

distractorWhy.1: "Were" is used for plural subjects, whereas both Andre and his armor are singular.
distractorWhy.2: "Armor" is singular and requires "was", not "were".
distractorWhy.3: "Andre" is singular and requires "was", not "were".

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 2 ("Time Travel Car"), Monita enters a strange flying car outside her house. How does Monita start the car engine?
options: By pressing the big red button located at the center of the dashboard panel
By turning a silver key inside the ignition switch
By shouting a magical phrase to the car dashboard
By pulling the emergency handbrake next to her seat

why.0: The text states: "One big red button was located at the center of the panel. Push the red button to start... Then, she pressed the red button."

distractorWhy.1: The car did not use a silver key; it was activated by pressing a big red button on the dashboard panel.
distractorWhy.2: The car spoke to Monita, but starting it required pressing the red button rather than shouting magic words.
distractorWhy.3: Monita fastened her seatbelt after starting the car with the red button, not by pulling a handbrake.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 5, Monita is questioned in Banjarmasin about her school, SMP Merdeka. Why is the local resident / security officer surprised by Monita's statement?
options: Because Monita traveled back to 1992, and SMP Merdeka was not established until 2014
Because SMP Merdeka is located in Jakarta, not in Banjarmasin
Because Monita forgot the exact address of her home in Banjarmasin
Because the security officer had already graduated from SMP Merdeka long ago

why.0: The security officer explains that there is no SMP Merdeka in 1992 because SMP Merdeka was only established in 2014, revealing Monita's time travel to the past.

distractorWhy.1: Monita states she lives in Banjarmasin near SMP Merdeka, but the issue is the time period (1992 vs 2014), not the city.
distractorWhy.2: Monita knows her address in Banjarmasin, but the school does not exist yet in 1992.
distractorWhy.3: The officer did not attend SMP Merdeka; he states the school does not exist in 1992.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 3 (Worksheet 3.12), the text includes an informational snippet about time travel: "Is time travel possible? According to Albert Einstein, ..." What principle is mentioned regarding time travel?
options: Time and space are linked together
Time moves backward only during full moons
Time travel requires a magic spell and a potion
Space is completely separate from time

why.0: According to the text in Unit 2 Section 3, Albert Einstein proposed that time and space are linked together.

distractorWhy.1: The text discusses scientific theories by Albert Einstein, not lunar cycles.
distractorWhy.2: The passage references physics concepts by Albert Einstein rather than magical spells or potions.
distractorWhy.3: Einstein's theory states that time and space are linked together, not separate.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 4 ("Language Focus: Indirect Speech"), learn how to report questions. Convert this direct Wh- question into indirect speech: Monita asked, "Where can I buy this newspaper?"
options: Monita asked where she could buy that newspaper.
Monita asked where can she buy this newspaper.
Monita asked if she could buy this newspaper where.
Monita asked where did she buy that newspaper.

why.0: In indirect Wh- questions, the question word ("where") is kept, subject-verb order changes to statement word order ("she could buy"), past tense modal ("can" -> "could") is used, and "this" changes to "that".

distractorWhy.1: In indirect speech, question word order ("can she") must change to statement word order ("she could").
distractorWhy.2: Wh- questions retain the question word at the beginning of the reported clause rather than using "if".
distractorWhy.3: Auxiliary "did" is not inserted for reported modal questions; "can" changes directly to "could".

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 4 (Worksheet 3.14), convert this direct Yes/No question into indirect speech: The security officer asked, "Do you want to meet the professor?"
options: The security officer asked if she wanted to meet the professor.
The security officer asked that did she want to meet the professor.
The security officer asked where she wanted to meet the professor.
The security officer asked whether does she want to meet the professor.

why.0: For reported Yes/No questions, we use "if" or "whether", change question structure to statement order, and backshift present tense ("do you want") to past tense ("she wanted").

distractorWhy.1: Reported questions do not use "that did she want"; they use "if/whether" followed by statement word order.
distractorWhy.2: "Where" is used for location questions, whereas this is a Yes/No question requiring "if" or "whether".
distractorWhy.3: In indirect speech, present tense "does she want" must backshift to past tense "she wanted".

items.prompt: From Progress Check 2 (No. 1), convert the following direct speech into indirect speech: Andre asked, "What do you want to buy in the supermarket?"
options: Andre asked what I wanted to buy in the supermarket.
Andre asked what do I want to buy in the supermarket.
Andre asked if I wanted to buy what in the supermarket.
Andre asked what did I want to buy in the supermarket.

why.0: The Wh- question "What do you want..." becomes "what I wanted..." in reported speech, shifting present tense to past tense and changing question order to statement order.

distractorWhy.1: Present tense "do I want" must be backshifted to past tense "I wanted" in reported speech.
distractorWhy.2: Wh- questions use the question word ("what") directly after the reporting verb, not "if".
distractorWhy.3: Indirect speech uses statement order ("what I wanted") without auxiliary "did".

items.prompt: From Progress Check 2 (No. 5), convert the direct speech into indirect speech: Monita asked, "Do you like the moon orchid?"
options: Monita asked whether I liked the moon orchid.
Monita asked what I liked the moon orchid.
Monita asked if did I like the moon orchid.
Monita asked that I liked the moon orchid.

why.0: Yes/No questions use "if" or "whether", backshifting "do you like" to "I liked" in statement word order.

distractorWhy.1: "What" is used for Wh- content questions, not for Yes/No questions.
distractorWhy.2: Reported questions do not combine "if" with auxiliary "did".
distractorWhy.3: Reported questions use "if" or "whether" instead of the conjunction "that".

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Section 4 ("Writing: Stages of a Narrative Text"), Table 3.1 describes the stages of narrative text structure. What is the main description of the Orientation stage?
options: It describes the setting in time and place and introduces the main characters or narrator.
It describes a sequence of unusual or problematic events faced by characters.
It deals with attempts to solve or overcome the main problem.
It provides an optional overall evaluation of events and moral lessons.

why.0: According to Table 3.1 in Unit 3 Section 4, Orientation describes the setting in time and place and introduces the main characters or narrator.

distractorWhy.1: Describing unusual or problematic events is the function of the Complication stage.
distractorWhy.2: Dealing with attempts to solve the problem is the function of the Resolution stage.
distractorWhy.3: Providing an evaluation or moral lesson is the function of the Coda stage.

items.prompt: In narrative text structure (Unit 3 Section 4), which stage describes a sequence of events where a problem or conflict arises for the main characters?
options: Complication
Orientation
Resolution
Coda

why.0: Complication is the stage in a narrative text where problematic, unusual, or conflicting events occur.

distractorWhy.1: Orientation introduces the characters and setting before the problem begins.
distractorWhy.2: Resolution shows how the problem is solved.
distractorWhy.3: Coda provides the concluding evaluation or moral lesson.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Section 4, what happens during the Resolution stage of a narrative text structure?
options: The characters make attempts to solve or overcome the problem
The background setting and time period are first introduced
The central conflict reaches its highest point of mystery without solution
The author listed past action verbs in comic panels

why.0: Table 3.1 defines Resolution as the stage that deals with attempts to solve or overcome the problem in the story.

distractorWhy.1: Introducing background setting and time period is the Orientation stage.
distractorWhy.2: Reaching the peak conflict without solution belongs to the Complication phase.
distractorWhy.3: Listing past action verbs is a classroom writing activity, not a narrative text stage.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Table 3.2 ("The Multiverse Story of Timun Mas"), what special items does Timun Mas's mother give her in this modern fantasy version to help her beat the Giant?
options: A pencil, a pen, and an eraser
Cucumber seeds, salt, and shrimp paste
A magical shield, a sword, and plate armor
A time travel car and a digital map

why.0: In the multiverse adaptation presented in Table 3.2, Timun Mas's mother gives her three stationery items: a pencil, a pen, and an eraser.

distractorWhy.1: Cucumber seeds, salt, and shrimp paste belong to the traditional folklore version, whereas this multiverse version uses school supplies.
distractorWhy.2: Magical shield and plate armor are from Andre's knight outfit in Unit 1.
distractorWhy.3: A time travel car belongs to Monita's story in Unit 2.

items.prompt: In the multiverse story of Timun Mas (Unit 3 Section 4 text snippet), how do Timun Mas and the Giant successfully escape from the labyrinth?
options: Timun Mas reads the digital map while the Giant uses his strong power to destroy obstacles along the way.
Timun Mas throws salt to turn the labyrinth into a muddy sea.
The Giant carries Timun Mas on a flying time travel car through the green flash.
Princess Suripit guides them out using a black orchid.

why.0: The text states: "Alright, we should use a digital map. You can read the map for us... Using his strong power, the Giant destroyed the obstacles along the way... Timun Mas and the Giant successfully found their way out."

distractorWhy.1: Throwing salt to create a muddy sea is from the traditional folk tale, not the multiverse labyrinth scene.
distractorWhy.2: The flying time travel car belongs to Monita's story in Unit 2.
distractorWhy.3: Princess Suripit and the black orchid belong to Andre's story in Unit 1.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Section 5 (Worksheet 3.24), students analyze past action verbs in narrative comics. Which option contains ONLY past action verbs?
options: pressed, destroyed, carried, opened
beautiful, brave, shiny, excited
because, although, suddenly, happily
is, are, was, were

why.0: "Pressed", "destroyed", "carried", and "opened" are past action verbs describing physical actions performed in the past.

distractorWhy.1: "Beautiful", "brave", "shiny", and "excited" are adjectives, not action verbs.
distractorWhy.2: "Because", "although", "suddenly", and "happily" are conjunctions and adverbs.
distractorWhy.3: "Is", "are", "was", and "were" are linking verbs / auxiliaries, not physical action verbs.

items.prompt: Chapter 3 explores fantasy stories, time travel, and multiverse folk tales. What main lesson about problem-solving is emphasized in narrative texts (Unit 3 Section 4)?
options: Characters find creative solutions to overcome unexpected problems through intelligence, courage, and cooperation.
Characters should avoid all challenges and never venture into unknown worlds.
Problems can only be solved by using physical violence against opponents.
Fantasy worlds must always end with characters remaining trapped forever.

why.0: Unit 3 Section 4 highlights that narrative texts entertain and convey messages about how characters find solutions to their unusual and unexpected problems.

distractorWhy.1: Narrative texts encourage character growth and facing challenges, not avoiding them.
distractorWhy.2: The stories in Chapter 3 show peaceful or clever resolutions (e.g. Timun Mas studying at university, Andre completing missions).
distractorWhy.3: The resolution stage in narrative texts provides a way out, enabling characters to overcome their problems.

items.prompt: In Progress Check 2 (No. 3), convert the following direct speech into indirect speech: Pipit asked, "Can I see your notes?"
options: Pipit asked if she could see my notes.
Pipit asked can she see my notes.
Pipit asked that she saw my notes.
Pipit asked where she can see my notes.

why.0: The Yes/No modal question "Can I see..." is reported using "if", changing subject "I" to "she", modal "can" to past form "could", and pronoun "your" to "my".

distractorWhy.1: Reported questions must use statement order ("she could see") and backshift "can" to "could".
distractorWhy.2: Indirect questions do not use "that"; they use "if" or "whether".
distractorWhy.3: "Where" is used for location questions, whereas "Can I see..." is a Yes/No question requiring "if".

competencies.name: Chapter 4: Upcycling Used Materials
competencies.materi: Upcycling & Recycling Crafts Procedural Texts, Imperative Action Verbs, DIY Project Instructions, Environmental Sustainability
competencies.cpRef: English for Nusantara untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VII — Chapter 4 (Kelas IX)

items.prompt: In Unit 1 (Look at My Creation, Section 2), Galang, Monita, and Andre are discussing ideas for their school bazaar project. What items do they decide to make from used plastic water bottles and bottle caps?
options: Wall decorations and pencil holders
Plastic keychains and shopping bags
Water bottles and flower pots
Storage boxes and decorative lamps

why.0: Galang, Monita, dan Andre sepakat memanfaatkan botol plastik bekas untuk membuat hiasan dinding (wall decoration) dan botolnya menjadi tempat pensil (pencil holder).

distractorWhy.1: Gantungan kunci dan tas belanja plastik bukan merupakan produk daur ulang botol yang disepakati oleh mereka dalam percakapan.
distractorWhy.2: Botol air baru dan pot bunga tidak sesuai dengan produk utama yang mereka rencanakan dalam diskusi kelompok.
distractorWhy.3: Kotak penyimpanan dan lampu hias bukan kreasi yang dirancang oleh Monita dan teman-teman dari botol air bekas.

items.prompt: Based on Unit 1 Section 2 (Audio 4.2), what is the main purpose of Monita using green craft paper for their plastic bottle wall decoration project?
options: To cover the cardboard base to make it look neat and attractive
To stick the bottle caps directly onto the plastic bottle surface
To wrap the entire plastic bottle before cutting it into pieces
To replace the plastic bottle caps with paper cutouts

why.0: Dalam petunjuk pembuatan kreasi hiasan dinding, kertas kerajinan hijau digunakan untuk melapisi alas karton agar tampak rapi dan menarik.

distractorWhy.1: Kertas hijau tidak ditempelkan langsung pada permukaan botol plastik melainkan pada karton dasar.
distractorWhy.2: Botol plastik tidak dibungkus seluruhnya dengan kertas sebelum dipotong dalam langkah pembuatan.
distractorWhy.3: Kertas hijau digunakan sebagai alas latar, bukan untuk menggantikan tutup botol plastik.

items.prompt: Read the following imperative step from a DIY procedural text in Unit 1: "______ the plastic bottle into two halves using a pair of scissors carefully." Which action verb correctly completes this imperative instruction?
options: Cut
Glue
Paint
Decorate

why.0: Kata kerja imperatif Cut (potong) paling tepat untuk mengawali instruksi membagi botol plastik menjadi dua bagian menggunakan gunting.

distractorWhy.1: Glue (rekatkan/lem) tidak cocok digunakan untuk memisahkan botol menjadi dua bagian menggunakan gunting.
distractorWhy.2: Paint (cat/mewarnai) digunakan untuk memberi warna, bukan untuk membagi botol menjadi dua bagian.
distractorWhy.3: Decorate (menghias) adalah proses mempercantik benda, bukan tindakan memotong botol.

items.prompt: In Unit 1 Section 3 (Language Focus), how are adjectives ordered when describing upcycled craft materials (e.g., size, shape, color, material)? Which phrase follows the correct adjective order rules?
options: A small round green plastic cap
A plastic green round small cap
A green small plastic round cap
A round plastic small green cap

why.0: Urutan kata sifat (Adjective Order) yang benar mengikuti pola: Size (small) + Shape (round) + Color (green) + Material (plastic) + Noun (cap).

distractorWhy.1: Bahan (plastic) diletakkan di depan warna dan bentuk, memutarbalikkan aturan baku urutan kata sifat.
distractorWhy.2: Warna (green) ditempatkan sebelum ukuran (small) dan bahan sebelum bentuk, yang melanggar urutan standar.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk (round) diletakkan di depan bahan dan ukuran, tidak sesuai urutan Size-Shape-Color-Material.

items.prompt: In Unit 1 Section 4, Andre describes his upcycled craft creation: "I made a pencil holder using a large cylindrical blue plastic bottle." What material and physical traits are highlighted in this description?
options: Size (large), shape (cylindrical), color (blue), material (plastic)
Price (cheap), weight (heavy), age (old), origin (local)
Texture (rough), quality (bad), color (blue), shape (square)
Size (small), pattern (striped), material (glass), color (red)

why.0: Deskripsi memuat ukuran (large), bentuk (cylindrical), warna (blue), dan bahan asal daur ulang (plastic).

distractorWhy.1: Harga, berat, dan usia barang tidak disebutkan dalam gabungan frasa kata sifat deskriptif tersebut.
distractorWhy.2: Tekstur kasar dan bentuk persegi tidak sesuai dengan deskripsi botol plastik silinder biru.
distractorWhy.3: Ukuran kecil, pola garis, dan bahan kaca bertentangan dengan deskripsi botol plastik besar.

items.prompt: Consider the procedural text instructions for making an upcycled wall hanging from bottle caps in Unit 1: "First, collect 20 plastic bottle caps. Next, arrange them in a flower pattern. Then, glue each cap onto the cardboard backing." What is the main purpose of using sequence adverbs like "First", "Next", and "Then" in this text?
options: To guide the reader step-by-step through the logical order of the DIY process
To express the author's personal feelings about upcycling waste
To compare the quality of plastic bottles with glass bottles
To persuade readers to buy wall decorations at a high price

why.0: Kata keterangan urutan (sequence adverbs) bertindak sebagai penanda urutan kronologis langkah-langkah kerja dalam teks prosedur DIY.

distractorWhy.1: Kata penanda urutan tidak digunakan untuk menyuarakan perasaan pribadi atau opini penulis.
distractorWhy.2: Teks prosedur urutan tidak bertujuan membandingkan kualitas bahan bekas dengan bahan kaca.
distractorWhy.3: Urutan langkah bukan bertujuan membujuk pembeli dari segi harga barang.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 (They're on Sale!, Section 1), students present preloved and upcycled items at the school marketplace. What does the term "preloved items" mean in the context of eco-friendly practices?
options: Secondhand goods that are still in good condition and can be reused
Brand-new products bought straight from a factory
Broken items that cannot be repaired or used again
Waste materials that must be burned or buried immediately

why.0: Istilah preloved items mengacu pada barang bekas pakai yang masih berkualitas layak dan bagus untuk dimanfaatkan kembali.

distractorWhy.1: Barang preloved bukan merupakan produk yang baru dibeli langsung dari pabrik pabrikan.
distractorWhy.2: Barang rusak yang tidak dapat diperbaiki tergolong sampah/sampah rusaknya bukan preloved.
distractorWhy.3: Barang preloved disukai untuk diguna-ulang, bukan limbah yang harus dibakar atau ditimbun.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 2, Galang sells handmade upcycled pencil cases made from old denim jeans. What key information should be included in a promotional text or advertisement poster for such products?
options: Product name, material description, price, and eco-friendly benefits
Step-by-step recipes, cooking duration, and nutritional values
Historical origin of denim fabric and garment manufacturing history
List of school rules regarding classroom cleanliness

why.0: Iklan promosi produk daur ulang memerlukan nama produk, rincian bahan bekas yang dipakai, harga, dan keunggulan ramah lingkungan.

distractorWhy.1: Resep makanan dan nilai gizi relevan untuk produk kuliner, bukan kerajinan tempat pensil berbahan denim.
distractorWhy.2: Sejarah pabrik garmen terlalu luas dan tidak berfokus pada informasi penjualan produk daur ulang.
distractorWhy.3: Tata tertib kebersihan kelas bukan isi informasi promosi penjualan barang daur ulang.

items.prompt: Read the promo line from Unit 2: "Buy two upcycled denim pouches and get a free handmade keychain! Offer valid during the School Charity Bazaar." What is the primary objective of this promotional message?
options: To attract buyers and encourage sales of upcycled products during the bazaar
To instruct students on how to sew denim pouches from scratch
To inform students about the school schedule for upcoming exams
To warn visitors about the danger of plastic pollution

why.0: Pesan promosi dengan penawaran khusus bertujuan menarik pembeli dan meningkatkan penjualan barang daur ulang.

distractorWhy.1: Pesan ini adalah iklan penawaran beli, bukan panduan teks prosedur tentang cara menjahit kantong denim.
distractorWhy.2: Iklan bazaar tidak bertujuan menyampaikan jadwal ujian sekolah kepada siswa.
distractorWhy.3: Pesan ini berfokus pada penjualan produk, bukan surat peringatan bahaya pencemaran limbah.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 4 (Language Focus), expressions for asking and giving price are practiced for buying upcycled crafts. Which question appropriately asks for the price of an upcycled handbag?
options: How much does this upcycled handbag cost?
Where did you find this upcycled handbag?
What color is this upcycled handbag?
Why did you create this upcycled handbag?

why.0: Kalimat "How much does this upcycled handbag cost?" adalah ungkapan yang tepat untuk menanyakan harga barang.

distractorWhy.1: Menanyakan tempat menemukan barang mengarah pada lokasi asal, bukan menanyakan nominal harga.
distractorWhy.2: Menanyakan warna barang berfokus pada penampilan visual, bukan harga jual produk.
distractorWhy.3: Menanyakan alasan pembuatan berfokus pada tujuan proyek, bukan harga barang yang ditawarkan.

items.prompt: During a school charity sale (Unit 2), a customer asks: "Can I get a discount if I buy three plastic bottle pots?" Which response by the student seller offers a polite negotiation response?
options: Sure! You can have all three for twenty thousand rupiahs.
No, you cannot buy any items from our store today.
I don't care how many pots you want to buy.
Please throw your trash into the designated recycling bin.

why.0: Jawaban memberikan harga potongan (diskon) secara sopan dan menyetujui penawaran pembeli.

distractorWhy.1: Penolakan mentah-mentah untuk menjual barang terkesan tidak sopan dan merugikan transaksi penjualan.
distractorWhy.2: Pernyataan acuh tak acuh melanggar tata cara berkomunikasi sopan dalam kegiatan jual beli.
distractorWhy.3: Himbauan membuang sampah tidak relevan dengan pertanyaan penawaran diskon harga produk.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 6 (Reading Poster), a student crafts poster states: "Turn Waste into Treasure: Eco-Friendly Crafts on Sale! Support our green initiative this Friday." What underlying message is conveyed by the slogan "Turn Waste into Treasure"?
options: Discarded materials can be creatively converted into valuable and useful products
Real treasure chests filled with gold can be found in plastic waste bins
All school trash should be sold immediately without cleaning or processing
Buying recycled products is more expensive than buying gold

why.0: Slogan "Turn Waste into Treasure" bermakna mengubah sampah/barang bekas menjadi barang berguna yang memiliki nilai kreasi dan manfaat tinggi.

distractorWhy.1: Slogan ini bernilai kiasan daur ulang, bukan arti harfiah menemukan peti harta karun emas di tempat sampah.
distractorWhy.2: Sampah harus diolah dan dibersihkan menjadi kerajinan terlebih dahulu, bukan dijual mentah dalam keadaan kotor.
distractorWhy.3: Slogan tersebut tidak menyatakan bahwa produk daur ulang lebih mahal daripada harga emas.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 (Let's Donate, Section 1), students learn about community action for environmental sustainability. What is the main goal of organizing a student-run charity shop at school?
options: To collect preloved items, sell them, and donate the profits to social causes
To store unused furniture permanently inside classroom corners
To force students to buy new plastic toys every week
To compete with commercial shopping malls in the city center

why.0: Tujuan utama toko amal siswa (charity shop) adalah mengumpulkan barang layak pakai, menjualnya, lalu mendonasikan keuntungannya untuk aksi sosial.

distractorWhy.1: Toko amal bertujuan mendaur/menjual barang, bukan menumpuk perabotan bekas secara permanen di sudut kelas.
distractorWhy.2: Toko amal berfokus pada pemanfaatan barang bekas (preloved), bukan memaksa membeli mainan plastik baru.
distractorWhy.3: Kegiatan sekolah ini bersifat sosial dan edukatif, bukan untuk bersaing secara komersial dengan mal besar.

items.prompt: Read the excerpt from a school website post in Unit 3 Section 2: "At Merdeka Friday Shop, we accept clean preloved clothes, books, and handmade crafts. All profits go to helping local shelters." What type of text structure is used to describe the shop's operations?
options: Descriptive text highlighting features, items accepted, and donation goals
Narrative text about a fictional hero fighting plastic monsters
Recount text detailing a vacation trip to a recycling factory
Exposition text discussing global weather patterns

why.0: Teks tersebut merupakan teks deskriptif yang memaparkan fitur toko, barang yang diterima, serta tujuan donasi.

distractorWhy.1: Teks bukan dongeng naratif fiktif tentang pahlawan melawan monster sampah plastik.
distractorWhy.2: Teks memuat informasi profil toko saat ini, bukan catatan pengalamannya berlibur ke pabrik daur ulang.
distractorWhy.3: Topik bahasan berfokus pada toko amal sekolah, bukan eksposisi perubahan cuaca global.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Section 3 (Language Focus), passive voice is introduced to emphasize actions in DIY and donation contexts, such as: "Used plastic bottles ARE COLLECTED by students every Wednesday." Why is passive voice used in this sentence?
options: To place primary focus on the action performed and the object (plastic bottles) rather than the agent
To express future plans that will never take place
To ask a direct question to the school principal
To command someone to clean the classroom immediately

why.0: Kalimat pasif menekankan objek (used plastic bottles) dan tindakan pengumpulan yang dilakukan ketimbang subjek pelakunya.

distractorWhy.1: Bentuk pasif menyatakan fakta kegiatan rutin yang berlangsung, bukan pengada-adaan rencana yang takkan terjadi.
distractorWhy.2: Kalimat tersebut berbentuk berita/pernyataan, bukan kalimat tanya langsung kepada kepala sekolah.
distractorWhy.3: Struktur kalimat ini adalah pernyataan pasif deskriptif, bukan kalimat perintah imperatif.

items.prompt: Convert the active DIY procedure sentence into correct passive voice: "Students turn old newspapers into decorative paper baskets." Which sentence presents the correct passive form?
options: Old newspapers are turned into decorative paper baskets by students.
Old newspapers were turning decorative paper baskets for students.
Students are turned by old newspapers into decorative paper baskets.
Decorative paper baskets turn old newspapers by students.

why.0: Bentuk pasif dari kalimat Simple Present tersebut adalah "Old newspapers (object) + are turned (V3) + into decorative paper baskets + by students (agent)".

distractorWhy.1: Penggunaan tensis "were turning" salah karena kalimat asal menggunakan Simple Present tense.
distractorWhy.2: Makna kalimat tertukar secara tidak logis, seolah-olah siswa yang diubah oleh surat kabar tua.
distractorWhy.3: Keranjang kertas diletakkan sebagai subjek aktif yang mengubah koran, mengacaukan struktur pasif.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 Section 4, students write a description for their charity project. Which section structure correctly organizes a descriptive report about an eco-friendly project?
options: Identification (introducing the shop/project) followed by Description (details of items, pricing, and donation recipient)
Orientation (setting time/place), Complication (problem encountered), and Resolution (ending)
Goal (title), Materials needed, and Step-by-step instructions
Thesis statement, Arguments in support, and Reiteration conclusion

why.0: Struktur generik teks deskriptif proyek adalah Identification (pengenalan toko/proyek) dilanjutkan Description (rincian barang, harga, dan penyaluran donasi).

distractorWhy.1: Orientation-Complication-Resolution adalah struktur generik teks naratif (cerita dongeng/pengalaman).
distractorWhy.2: Goal-Materials-Steps merupakan struktur generik teks prosedur pembuatan/panduan DIY.
distractorWhy.3: Thesis-Arguments-Reiteration merupakan struktur generik teks eksposisi analitis.

items.prompt: Read the DIY project step: "______ the glued plastic caps with acrylic paint to give them a vibrant appearance before attaching them to the wall frame." Which imperative action verb fits best?
options: Coat
Wash
Melt
Burn

why.0: Kata kerja Coat (melapisi/mewarnai dengan lapisan cat) paling pas untuk memberi warna akrilik pada tutup botol.

distractorWhy.1: Wash (mencuci) dilakukan dengan air di awal pembersihan, bukan saat melapisi dengan cat akrilik.
distractorWhy.2: Melt (mencairkan) akan merusak tutup botol plastik dan berbahaya dalam proyek hiasan dinding sederhana.
distractorWhy.3: Burn (membakar) merusak bahan daur ulang serta merilis gas beracun yang bertentangan dengan prinsip ramah lingkungan.

items.prompt: In a DIY instruction guide for making a plant pot from a plastic bottle, what is the importance of adding the step: "Puncture small holes in the bottom of the plastic bottle"?
options: To allow excess water to drain out so the plant roots do not rot
To make the plastic bottle lighter so it can float in the air
To prevent sunlight from reaching the soil inside the pot
To store extra fertilizer at the base of the bottle container

why.0: Lubang kecil di dasar botol berfungsi sebagai saluran drainase air agar akar tanaman tidak membusuk.

distractorWhy.1: Memberi lubang pada pot plastik tidak membuat pot tersebut melayang di udara.
distractorWhy.2: Lubang bawah tidak bertujuan menahan sinar matahari mengenai tanah tanaman.
distractorWhy.3: Lubang di bagian bawah justru membuat cairan mengalir keluar, bukan untuk menyimpan pupuk.

items.prompt: Reflecting on Chapter 4 ("Upcycling Used Materials"), how do upcycling projects contribute to environmental sustainability in school communities?
options: By reducing plastic waste in landfills, reusing existing resources creatively, and fostering social responsibility through donation
By encouraging people to produce more single-use plastic bottles every day
By replacing natural plants with artificial plastic flowers across all gardens
By increasing the amount of trash thrown into local rivers

why.0: Daur ulang (upcycling) mengurangi volume sampah, memanfaatkan kembali sumber daya secara kreatif, dan memupuk kepedulian sosial melalui kegiatan donasi.

distractorWhy.1: Upcycling bertujuan mengurangi limbah, bukan mendorong produksi botol plastik sekali pakai lebih banyak.
distractorWhy.2: Daur ulang tidak bertujuan mengganti semua tanaman alami dengan bunga plastik di taman.
distractorWhy.3: Daur ulang mencegah dan mengurangi pembuangan sampah ke sungai, bukan menambah jumlah pencemaran.

competencies.name: Chapter 5: Digital Life
competencies.materi: Digital Literacy & Online Safety, Analytical Exposition Texts, Expressing Arguments & Opinions, Cyber Etiquette
competencies.cpRef: English for Nusantara untuk SMP/MTs Kelas VII — Chapter 5 (Kelas IX)

items.prompt: In Section 2 of Unit 1 (Let's Check the Facts!), Galang asks Monita how to search for information on the internet. According to Monita, what is the very first step to do before typing keywords?
options: Open a web browser on a laptop or smartphone
Click on the first advertisement link in search results
Type a complete paragraph into the address bar
Turn off the internet connection and restart the computer

why.0: Berdasarkan dialog Galang dan Monita di Unit 1, langkah paling awal saat ingin mencari informasi adalah membuka peramban web (web browser) di perangkat komputer atau ponsel pintar.

distractorWhy.1: Mengklik iklan secara langsung berisiko mengarahkan ke situs yang tidak aman atau tidak relevan.
distractorWhy.2: Ketiklah kata kunci utama (keywords) di kolom pencarian, bukan mengetik seluruh paragraf panjang.
distractorWhy.3: Mematikan koneksi internet justru membuat peramban web tidak dapat mengakses mesin pencari.

items.prompt: Based on Monita's advice to Galang in Unit 1, why is it essential to check the source of information found on the internet?
options: In order to avoid using false or misleading information
To increase the internet connection speed
To automatically download pocket book templates
To change the browser's default background color

why.0: Monita menjelaskan bahwa memeriksa sumber informasi (source of information) sangat penting agar kita terhindar dari penggunaan data atau informasi palsu (false information).

distractorWhy.1: Memeriksa sumber data adalah tindakan verifikasi keabsahan isi, bukan untuk mempercepat koneksi internet.
distractorWhy.2: Memeriksa kredibilitas sumber tidak mengunduh templat secara otomatis.
distractorWhy.3: Sumber informasi berkaitan dengan isi materi, bukan pengaturan warna tampilan peramban.

items.prompt:
Read the passage from Unit 1 Section 7:
'Facts about search engines: Internet users must be familiar with search engines. It only takes a few seconds for search engines to find desired information. Search engines put relevant sites at the top of the search results... Everyday there are more than 500 million searches completed.'

How do search engines organize search results to help users find information quickly?
options: By placing the most relevant websites at the top of the results list
By sorting websites strictly in alphabetical order of their full URLs
By hiding secure websites and displaying unverified blogs first
By randomly changing the order of search results every few seconds

why.0: Teks 'Facts about search engines' menyebutkan bahwa mesin pencari menempatkan situs-situs yang paling relevan di urutan paling atas (top of the search results) agar pengguna dapat menemukan informasi dengan cepat.

distractorWhy.1: Mesin pencari mengurutkan hasil berdasarkan relevansi dan peringkat algoritma, bukan urutan abjad URL.
distractorWhy.2: Mesin pencari memprioritaskan situs terverifikasi dan relevan, bukan menyembunyikannya.
distractorWhy.3: Urutan pencarian disusun secara terstruktur sesuai relevansi pencarian, bukan diacak secara acak setiap detik.

items.prompt: According to Ibu Ida Ayu's instructions in Unit 1 on making a biography pocket book, which action verb correctly completes the step: '______ the key words in the search box'?
options: Type
Erase
Fold
Glue

why.0: Kata kerja imperatif yang tepat untuk menggunakan kolom pencarian (search box) di peramban web adalah 'Type' (ketiklah kata kunci).

distractorWhy.1: 'Erase' berarti menghapus, bukan tindakan memasukkan kata kunci pencarian.
distractorWhy.2: 'Fold' adalah instruksi melipat kertas saat membuat buku saku, bukan perintah di peramban.
distractorWhy.3: 'Glue' adalah tindakan menempelkan bahan kertas.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 (Staying safe in the digital world), students learn digital security terms. What is the definition of 'privacy settings' on digital devices and social media?
options: Controls that allow users to manage who can see their personal information and posts
A public list of passwords shared with all online friends
Hardware tools used to increase the display brightness of a screen
An automatic notification sent to unknown internet users

why.0: 'Privacy settings' (pengaturan privasi) adalah fitur keamanan yang memungkinkan pengguna mengatur siapa saja yang berhak melihat data pribadi maupun unggahan mereka.

distractorWhy.1: Kata sandi tidak boleh dibuat menjadi daftar publik yang dibagikan kepada teman online.
distractorWhy.2: Pengaturan privasi adalah fitur perangkat lunak keamanan digital, bukan pengatur kecerahan layar.
distractorWhy.3: Pengaturan privasi bertujuan membatasi akses orang tidak dikenal, bukan mengirim notifikasi otomatis kepada mereka.

items.prompt:
Read the rule from 'Internet Safety Rules' in Unit 2 Section 2:
'Verify a link is safe... Know about hovering. Hovering is when you place your mouse cursor over a link (without clicking it) to see the link embedded in the text.'

What should an internet user do if the embedded web address shown during hovering differs from the visible text link?
options: Never click the link because it may be suspicious or fraudulent
Immediately forward the link to all contacts in your address book
Click the link twice to force the browser to fix the web address
Enter your personal banking password on the displayed page

why.0: Aturan keselamatan internet di Unit 2 menegaskan bahwa jika alamat tautan yang tersembunyi berbeda dari teks yang terlihat saat dilayangkan kursor (hovering), tautan tersebut tidak boleh diklik (never click it) karena berpotensi jebakan/scam.

distractorWhy.1: Meneruskan tautan mencurigakan ke orang lain dapat menyebarkan ancaman siber.
distractorWhy.2: Mengklik tautan berbeda dua kali tetap dapat mengarahkan ke situs peretas atau malware.
distractorWhy.3: Memasukkan kata sandi rahasia pada situs mencurigakan sangat berbahaya dan memicu pencurian identitas.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 5 ('10 Ways to Protect Yourself Against Cybercrimes'), what is recommended regarding passwords to protect your digital accounts against unauthorized access?
options: Keep passwords secret from peers and change them regularly
Share passwords with online gaming acquaintances to gain bonus points
Use your full name and date of birth as a simple password for all websites
Post your passwords on social media profiles so you never forget them

why.0: Poin ke-6 dari 10 cara perlindungan diri di Unit 2 menyarankan agar kata sandi dijaga kerahasiaannya dan diubah secara berkala (change it regularly).

distractorWhy.1: Membagikan kata sandi kepada kenalan online dapat menyebabkan akun diretas.
distractorWhy.2: Menggunakan nama lengkap dan tanggal lahir membuat kata sandi sangat mudah ditebak peretas.
distractorWhy.3: Mengunggah kata sandi di profil media sosial akan menghilangkan perlindungan akun.

items.prompt: According to the UNICEF survey text presented in Unit 2 ('Online bullying in Indonesia'), what percentage of the 2,777 young Indonesians surveyed had experienced cyberbullying?

why.0: Teks hasil survei UNICEF 2019 di Unit 2 menyebutkan bahwa dari 2.777 remaja Indonesia berusia 14-24 tahun, sebanyak 45% pernah mengalami perundungan siber (cyberbullying).

distractorWhy.1: Angka 10% terlalu rendah dan tidak sesuai dengan data resmi survei di buku teks.
distractorWhy.2: Angka 75% bukan merupakan data persentase total korban perundungan siber dalam teks tersebut.
distractorWhy.3: Angka 90% tidak menggambarkan data statistik yang tercantum pada materi Unit 2.

items.prompt: In Unit 2 Section 6, what safe action should a student take if they receive an abusive or nasty message from an unknown user on a messaging application?
options: Block the sender, screenshot the evidence, and tell a trusted adult
Reply with angry insults to retaliate against the sender
Delete your entire computer operating system immediately
Blame yourself and keep the abusive messages secret from everyone

why.0: Panduan penanganan cyberbullying di Unit 2 menyarankan untuk memblokir akun pengirim, menyimpan bukti berupa tangkapan layar (screenshot), dan melaporkannya kepada orang dewasa yang dipercaya.

distractorWhy.1: Membalas dengan hinaan akan memperkeruh konflik dan memicu perundungan balasan.
distractorWhy.2: Menghapus seluruh sistem operasi komputer adalah tindakan berlebihan yang tidak menyelesaikan masalah akun.
distractorWhy.3: Menyalahkan diri sendiri dan merahasikannya dapat mengganggu kesehatan mental korban perundungan.

items.prompt: Unit 2 focuses on imperative sentences for digital safety rules using adverbs of frequency 'always' or 'never'. Which of the following sentences correctly states an online safety rule?
options: Never give out personal information to strangers online.
Always share your home address on public forums.
Never check if a web address begins with HTTPS.
Always open email attachments from unknown senders.

why.0: Kalimat imperatif aturan keselamatan online yang benar adalah larangan memberikan informasi pribadi kepada orang asing ('Never give out personal information to strangers online').

distractorWhy.1: Membagikan alamat rumah di forum publik melanggar prinsip privasi dan keselamatan digital.
distractorWhy.2: Kita justru harus selalu memeriksa indikator HTTPS pada alamat situs web.
distractorWhy.3: Membuka lampiran email dari pengirim tak dikenal berisiko terkena virus atau malware.

items.prompt: In Unit 3 (Turn back hoax!), students learn how to check the source of internet news. Which top-level domain ending is typically associated with official educational institutions?
options: .edu
.com
.xyz
.temp

why.0: Unit 3 menjelaskan identifikasi alamat URL, di mana ekstensi domain '.edu' khusus digunakan oleh lembaga pendidikan resmi (educational institutions).

distractorWhy.1: Domain '.com' umumnya digunakan oleh organisasi komersial atau umum.
distractorWhy.2: Domain '.xyz' adalah domain tingkat atas umum yang sering dipakai situs komersial atau blog bebas.
distractorWhy.3: Domain '.temp' bukan merupakan ekstensi domain resmi lembaga pendidikan.

items.prompt: Unit 3 provides steps to identify fake news or hoaxes online. What should you do when encountering a sensational headline before sharing it on social media?
options: Cross-check the facts with reliable news sources and official websites
Immediately share the news to gain views and likes
Assume the news is true if it includes an dramatic photo
Rewrite the news with extra exaggerated details

why.0: Langkah utama menangkal hoaks di Unit 3 adalah memverifikasi dan mencocokkan fakta (cross-check facts) dengan sumber berita tepercaya sebelum menyebarkannya.

distractorWhy.1: Langsung menyebarkan berita demi jumlah suka (likes) memicu penyebaran informasi palsu.
distractorWhy.2: Foto dramatis sering diubah atau dipakai di luar konteks asli oleh pembuat hoaks.
distractorWhy.3: Menambah rincian berlebihan justru memperburuk kualitas dan kebenaran informasi.

items.prompt: In Chapter 5 Unit 3, analytical exposition texts are introduced to state arguments regarding digital issues. What is the standard generic structure of an analytical exposition text?
options: Thesis - Arguments - Reiteration / Conclusion
Goal - Materials - Steps
Orientation - Complication - Resolution
Identification - Description

why.0: Struktur generik teks eksposisi analitis (analytical exposition text) terdiri dari Tesis (penyataan pendapat utama), Argumen-argumen pendukung, dan Reinterasi/Kesimpulan (penegasan ulang tesis).

distractorWhy.1: Struktur 'Goal - Materials - Steps' merupakan struktur generik dari Teks Prosedur (Procedure Text).
distractorWhy.2: Struktur 'Orientation - Complication - Resolution' merupakan struktur generik dari Teks Naratif (Narrative Text).
distractorWhy.3: Struktur 'Identification - Description' merupakan struktur generik dari Teks Deskriptif (Descriptive Text).

items.prompt: What is the primary communicative purpose of an analytical exposition text discussed in digital literacy topics?
options: To persuade readers that a particular topic or issue is important by presenting logical arguments
To entertain readers with a fictional story about internet superheroes
To provide step-by-step instructions on how to assemble a computer desktop
To describe the physical appearance of a digital device in detail

why.0: Tujuan komunikatif teks eksposisi analitis adalah meyakinkan pembaca bahwa topik atau isu yang dibahas itu penting melalui argumen-argumen yang logis.

distractorWhy.1: Menghibur pembaca dengan cerita rekaan adalah tujuan dari teks naratif.
distractorWhy.2: Memberikan petunjuk langkah demi langkah melakukan sesuatu adalah tujuan teks prosedur.
distractorWhy.3: Mendeskripsikan penampilan fisik suatu benda secara detail adalah tujuan teks deskriptif.

items.prompt: Which expression is commonly used to introduce a personal opinion or argument when discussing online etiquette in Unit 3?
options: In my opinion, we should always verify information before posting it.
Once upon a time, there lived a wise king in a digital kingdom.
First, cut the paper into two equal rectangular parts.
Congratulations on winning the internet safety competition!

why.0: Ungkapan 'In my opinion,...' adalah ungkapan standar untuk menyampaikan pendapat atau argumen pribadi dalam materi teks eksposisi dan etika digital.

distractorWhy.1: 'Once upon a time,...' adalah frasa pembuka dongeng/teks naratif.
distractorWhy.2: 'First, cut the paper...' merupakan instruksi dalam teks prosedur.
distractorWhy.3: 'Congratulations...' adalah ungkapan selamat (congratulating).

items.prompt: Analytical exposition texts rely heavily on the Simple Present Tense to state general truths and facts. Which sentence correctly uses the Simple Present Tense with proper subject-verb agreement?
options: A responsible internet user checks the credibility of news sources.
A responsible internet user checking the credibility of news sources yesterday.
A responsible internet user check the credibility of news sources tomorrow.
A responsible internet user were check the credibility of news sources.

why.0: Subjek tunggal 'A responsible internet user' membutuhkan kata kerja bentuk Simple Present Tense dengan akhiran -s, yaitu 'checks'.

distractorWhy.1: Penggunaan bentuk 'checking' dengan kata keterangan 'yesterday' melanggar kaidah Simple Present Tense.
distractorWhy.2: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal memerlukan kata kerja 'checks', bukan 'check' tanpa -s.
distractorWhy.3: Bentuk 'were check' secara tata bahasa tidak baku dan salah.

items.prompt: In Chapter 5, formal vocabulary related to digital ethics is introduced. Which word pair consists of synonyms relevant to online safety and verifying facts?
options: Verify - Confirm
Hoax - Truth
Scam - Protection
Suspicious - Trusted

why.0: Pasangan kata 'Verify' (memverifikasi) dan 'Confirm' (mengonfirmasi) adalah sinonim (persamaan kata) yang sesuai dalam konteks verifikasi kebenaran informasi digital.

distractorWhy.1: 'Hoax' (berita bohong) dan 'Truth' (kebenaran) adalah antonim (lawan kata).
distractorWhy.2: 'Scam' (penipuan) dan 'Protection' (perlindungan) adalah dua konsep yang berlawanan.
distractorWhy.3: 'Suspicious' (mencurigakan) dan 'Trusted' (dapat dipercaya) merupakan kata yang berlawanan arti.

items.prompt: Consider the following online situation: A news post headline claims 'Drinking salt water cures all viral infections instantly' without citing any medical research or doctor's name. Applying the steps from Unit 3 (Turn Back Hoax!), how should a digitally literate student evaluate this post?
options: Classify it as potential hoax/misinformation because it lacks credible scientific evidence and source verification
Accept it as real news because the headline contains strong exclamation marks
Share it immediately to all family chat groups to prevent illness
Assume it is authentic because it was posted on an unverified personal blog

why.0: Berdasarkan langkah-langkah penangkalan hoaks di Unit 3, klaim medis tanpa bukti ilmiah dan tanpa rujukan pihak berwenang wajib dikategorikan sebagai potensi hoaks/disinformasi.

distractorWhy.1: Tanda seru pada judul berita sering digunakan oleh pembuat berita sensasional/palsu untuk memancing emosi pembaca.
distractorWhy.2: Menyebarkan informasi medis yang belum terbukti kebenaran ilmiahnya dapat membahayakan kesehatan orang lain.
distractorWhy.3: Unggahan di blog pribadi tanpa verifikasi bukan merupakan sumber warta resmi yang tepercaya.

items.prompt: What is the key takeaway regarding cyber etiquette when interacting on social media platforms as outlined in Chapter 5?
options: Think critically before sharing information and respect others' privacy online
Post every personal detail of your daily life to maintain online popularity
Comment harsh critiques on strangers' photos to express freedom of speech
Use other people's account passwords whenever you need internet access

why.0: Inti dari etika digital (cyber etiquette) di Chapter 5 adalah berpikir kritis sebelum membagikan informasi (think before sharing) serta menghormati hak privasi orang lain.

distractorWhy.1: Mengunggah seluruh detail pribadi mengabaikan prinsip keamanan dan privasi data.
distractorWhy.2: Komentar kasar dan menghina melanggar etika digital dan tergolong perundungan siber.
distractorWhy.3: Menggunakan akun milik orang lain tanpa izin merupakan pelanggaran keamanan digital.

items.prompt: In Chapter 5 (Digital Life), which combination of actions best demonstrates a student who practices good digital literacy and online safety?
options: Using strong passwords, verifying news sources, and reporting cyberbullying
Sharing account passwords with friends, clicking unknown web links, and spreading unverified news
Ignoring browser security warnings, downloading illegal attachments, and insulting online users
Using fake identities to scam others, disabling firewall protections, and hiding passwords under keyboards

why.0: Kombinasi penggunaan kata sandi kuat, memverifikasi berita, dan melaporkan perundungan siber adalah bentuk nyata dari literasi digital dan keselamatan online yang baik.

distractorWhy.1: Membagikan kata sandi dan mengklik tautan tidak dikenal adalah tindakan berisiko tinggi terhadap kejahatan siber.
distractorWhy.2: Abaikan peringatan keamanan dan mengunduh lampiran ilegal dapat merusak sistem komputer.
distractorWhy.3: Penipuan identitas dan mematikan benteng keamanan (firewall) melanggar etika serta hukum digital.
